newsitems.title: Apex Legends™: Ranked Roadmap
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/addba2b9b0a8d75ddf850b7afbdb0a76eafbbdfc.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]TLDR;[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Read on to hear all about major changes to Ranked coming in Season 31 and 32, including:[/p][list][*][p]NEW Legend Banning[/p][/*][*][p]Scoring adjustments for wide-skill matches[/p][/*][*][p]UI clarity improvements[/p][/*][*][p]NEW Iron, Emerald, and Grandmaster Ranks[/p][/*][*][p]NEW Pro-Am League[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked rewards overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]and more![/p][/*][/list][h2][b]INTRO[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Over the next two seasons, we are adding major improvements and features to Ranked mode in Apex Legends™. As we worked to create these additions, we had a few guiding design philosophies; things we want to ensure that players feel about the mode:[/p][list][*][p]Ranked is the most competitive way to play Apex Legends[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked is rewarding for all who play[/p][/*][*][p]Ranked provides more ways to showcase your accomplishments[/p][/*][*][p]There is trust in fairness of competition[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]While you read about the changes coming to the next two seasons, keep in mind: This isn’t everything. There are more changes to come, both in the short term and beyond Season 32, and as we approach each season, we will provide more detailed information about the additions and changes. Keep an eye out for more updates down the line![/p][h2][b]SEASON 31[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 31, starting in November, we’re adding a Legend Ban system in Diamond+ matches, meaningful score adjustments, and other quality of life improvements. The intention here is to make changes that provide tangible value to players and lay the foundation for larger changes that come in Season 32, in early 2027.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h3][b]LEGEND BANNING[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Legend Banning has been a long-discussed feature, internally and externally, and we’re excited to bring it to life in Season 31 to help break up dominant metas at high-tier Ranked play, and keep the Ranked experience fresh and exciting. Legend Banning will be enabled alongside Drop Zone deployment, so that any match with Diamond+ players will use the feature. [/p][p][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5MLwY6NtTx3xMlLBRjdgJ8/54483a79d30fe84d555f90aa0f128ca1/Apex_2026_Legend_Ban_Vid_-_Thumbnail.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The pre-match flow for Diamond+ matches now includes a dedicated Banning Phase, where each player will get to choose one Legend for possible banning.[/p][p align="start"]Once all players have elected a Legend for banning (or the selection timer expires), all chosen Legends will display their chance of being banned for that match. The percent chance of being banned is determined by the total votes for that Legend - more votes, higher chance of being banned.[/p][p align="start"]The system then randomly selects Legends using the percentages, and players move onto the Legend Selection phase where banned Legends cannot be chosen by any player for that match.[/p][p align="start"][i][b]Why not just ban the most-voted Legends, you ask?[/b][/i][/p][p align="start"]While we did consider this as a solution, the overall goal of Legend Banning is to help keep the meta fresh by disrupting dominant patterns in Legend picks. A system that consistently bans the most-voted Legends creates its own banning meta, and it works directly against that goal. [/p][p align="start"]As with all of our new features, we will monitor how this impacts Legend selection across all games, and continue to iterate on it as we find opportunities for improvement.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]SCORING ADJUSTMENTS FOR WIDE-SKILL LOBBIES[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 31, while we continue to refine matchmaking, we’re making changes to entry costs to make matches with wide skill distributions feel more fair.[/p][p align="start"]In Ranked games, our matchmaker works to balance queue times and RP match width. During periods of low population we see both queue times and match width increase, occasionally resulting in long queue times or lobbies with very wide spread of Rank Tiers. We are introducing these scoring changes to reflect the risk (and opportunity for reward!) that these games represent for all of the players involved.[/p][p align="start"]Each Ranked lobby will have a “Lobby Tier” designation visible upon loading into a match; essentially the median of all squads. Any squad that is 2 or more Rank Tiers above or below the lobby’s Ranked Tier will have their entry costs adjusted.[/p][p align="start"]If you are two or more tiers [i]below[/i] the Lobby Tier, you will be entering a CHALLENGER match and your entry costs will be reduced.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1g7Tev1JwKJxdBuDi19xjq/7624e68b97ad781757c2a7fc965ee8ba/02._Challenger_Match.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.7427790788446527,yPosition=0.8575305291723202" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In theory, your chance of winning that match is lower, so we want Entry Costs to align. If you do manage to come out ahead, congrats, you beat the odds and probably need to be in a higher Rank Tier anyways.[/p][p align="start"]If you are two or more tiers [i]above[/i] the Lobby Tier, you’re loading into a GOLIATH match, and will see increased entry costs.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7JeHlyDvzCpn6x7rGAIt9H/f1c4fab90d8b0aadb47cf9b1876a944a/03._Goliath_Match.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.697111631537861,yPosition=0.8975576662143826" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Your chance of winning is much much higher and your Entry Cost will be increased to reflect it. You should be able to feast on all those lowbies, and still come out RP positive, right?[/p][p align="start"]Let’s look at an example:[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/TvrquvCJVZSnVDYBYhFhL/92791b702ecf5f467ae19a3953af98bb/04._Wide_Match.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.1758391881342701,yPosition=0.08955223880597014" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In the above match, the Lobby Tier is set at Gold. Gold, Silver and Platinum squads are within acceptable bounds, but the Bronze squads will be marked as Challengers, and the Diamond squad will be marked as Goliaths.[/p][p align="start"]We want it to be clear what type of match you are going into, to help you strategize how you want to approach each lobby. This is why the RP adjustment is made to the Entry Cost, instead of being revealed only at the end. We want you to understand what has to be done in this match to break even and go positive in RP.[/p][p align="start"]For this change to scoring, we’ll be keeping a very close eye on player progression, as well as how much of an Entry Cost adjustment is required to reward players that can overcome the odds, and to prevent extreme boosting of squads that can easily nuke the entire lobby.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]EASIER ACCESS TO RANKED[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Road to Ranked Challenges are being removed and access to Ranked will move back to only requiring  Account Level 20. We will continue to explore the specific level threshold to find the perfect fit to provide the best player experience for all. [/p][p align="start"]Road to Ranked was intended as a skill-check for new accounts, ensuring that new players understood the rules of BR Trios, and had enough time on sticks to prove to themselves (and their future squadmates) that they were ready for the big leagues.[/p][p align="start"]Ultimately, we found that the current set of challenges were not as effective as we would have liked, AND the completion of the challenges took some players too much time and effort.[/p][p align="start"]We understand that some players may be concerned about the ease of access opening the door to waves of cheaters; rest assured our anti-cheat team is working hard to address these competitive integrity needs.[/p][p align="start"]Ranked is a great mode, and we want to provide more consistent access moving forward. The more players that can get into Ranked, the higher the overall match quality will be in terms of matchmaking, both for the lobby and for your squadmates.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]UI CLARITY IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2][h3][b]DEMOTION PROTECTION[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This is an existing feature that provides limited protection to players from being demoted to a lower Rank Tier. [/p][p align="start"]Ultimately, it was an unintentionally hidden feature, which we are giving a glow-up and will be better displayed for players when they are in the protected state.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1foADtBxaJUaqc9eBz74f1/42434d5c61a6c42b7a2e1545c35adc61/demotion_protection.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6,yPosition=0.4759916492693111" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Demotion Protection activates if you are at risk of being demoted to a lower Rank Tier from a single match, i.e. if you end up in a Goliath Match and the heightened entry cost could pull you down. While active, you get three Demotion Shields. Any time you would lose enough RP to be demoted, one Demotion Shield is used, and you will only be demoted after exhausting all of your Demotion Shields. Demotion Protection ends when you either gain enough RP so that it is no longer possible to demote from a single match or if you use all your shields and demote.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h1][b]SEASON 32[/b][/h1][p align="start"][i]BIG CHANGES AHEAD. HOLD ON TO YOUR AURAS![/i][/p][p align="start"]Ranked in Apex Legends has always had two distinct player types that keep coming back, season after season. We have our more casually competitive players that drop in for a split, play some games with friends, get promoted a couple of times and then move back to playing other modes. The other group is primarily our highest-skilled players, those that keep pushing through the entire season and generally finish their season in Diamond or Masters.[/p][p align="start"]For the first time in Ranked, we will be formally recognizing each of these groups and creating experiences that better cater to their collective wants and needs.[/p][p align="start"]We will be overhauling the Ranked tier structure and creating a clear separation between what we now call the Open League and the Pro-Am League.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6iGpl2Fdzkdopj6O8FKnyr/0c93cd36f317e1223817f535334ff078/06._Leagues_2.0.png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.49537037037037035" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][h2][b]NEW RANKS[/b][/h2][h3][b]IRON RANK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Rookie Rank has had a bunch of special rules associated with it that are not really required in Open League. As a result, we have replaced Rookie with Iron, which is treated like a standard rank for all players.[/p][h3][b]EMERALD RANK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Emerald Rank is new, and sits between Platinum and Diamond. It is the new threshold between Open and Pro-Am Leagues. It will have 4 Divisions, a new badge design, and will be added to Auras, to ensure that there is representation in and out of matches. Emerald Rank should help alleviate the bottleneck many players feel when they climb into Diamond.[/p][h3][b]GRANDMASTER RANK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Grandmasters Rank will sit at the very top of the Ranked progression runway. It will represent the absolute best of the best. To earn a Predator badge, you will need to land yourself in the top 750 of Grandmaster at the end of the Season.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]OPEN LEAGUE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Open League is where our aspiring Ranked players will fight it out, in hopes of playing in the Pro-Am League. All matches will start in the Dropship.[/p][p align="start"]With the addition of Emerald, there will be a rebalancing of RP values for progression, and you may find yourself adjusting your expectations on how far you are able to advance in this season based on your previous accomplishments. Just remember, everyone is in the same position as you are in dialling in how they place in this new structure![/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]INTRODUCING THE PRO-AM LEAGUE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The Pro-Am League will consist of Diamond, Masters and Grandmasters Rank tiers. Masters Rank will also contain 4 Divisions, to respect the commitment it will take to climb to Grandmasters. Pro-Am matches are where Drop Zone deployment and Legend Banning will live.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]RANKED REWARD CHANGES[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Ranked rewards have been a hot topic for as long as Ranked has existed, and we’re very excited to give a bit of a preview of what changes we have upcoming for this season. If this information seems a bit light, that is intentional. We will have a lot more details to share, with some wicked visuals, closer to Season 32’s launch.[/p][list][*][p]New Seasonal Auras[/p][/*][*][p]New ways to use Auras[/p][/*][*][p]Revisiting Ranked Dive Trails[/p][/*][*][p]Epic & Legendary Apex Packs[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards on Promotion, so you don’t have to wait until end of season[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]RANKED SCORING[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 32 we are overhauling the scoring system to improve the progression experience and make the scoring system easier to understand.[/p][p align="start"]Progression difficulty should gradually increase - not happen all at once - and the experience should be different for an average player compared to a professional player. RP math should be consistent, predictable, and should not require a calculator. [/p][h3][b]SCORE FLATTENING[/b][/h3][p align="start"]First, we are fully flattening the value from kills and placement.[/p][p align="start"]The previous formula allowed RP from kills to scale too much based on final placement, which was contributing to very aggressive hot drops and then ‘holding’ your kills through rounds to allow their value to increase. Starting in Season 32, each kill will be worth a set amount of RP, and each placement is worth a set amount of RP.[/p][p align="start"]By flattening the RP values and removing the multiplier between kills and placement, we expect to see  match pacing even out and players planning how they want to approach kills and survival in a more consistent way.[/p][h3][b]TEAM KILLS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To further clarify the scoring, you will get full kill RP from every kill your team gets regardless of your contribution. [/p][p align="start"]This means assists and participations are being removed.[/p][p align="start"]In addition to simplifying the scoring system, this refocuses individual success around team effort. The Apex Games are a team sport. If you are the team healer and you keep your fraggers alive, you deserve to be equally rewarded for your team’s success. [/p][h3][b]ENTRY COST CHANGES[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We will also be making the entry cost increases more granular by increasing entry cost at each [i][b]division[/b][/i] instead of each tier.[/p][p align="start"]Currently, we see many players hit a hard wall when entering a new Rank Tier ([i]looking at you, Diamond[/i]). With the large jumps in entry cost, it becomes substantially harder to continue netting positive RP.[/p][p align="start"]Increasing the entry cost by division will make progression through each division more competitive, and it will create a clearer measure of skill by separating more players along division lines, not only Rank Tiers.[/p][h3][b]OPEN VS. PRO-AM SCORING[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To serve the different player motivations of our more casually competitive players and our highest skill players, the Open League and the Pro-Am League will value Kills and Placement differently.[/p][p align="start"]The Open League will place more importance on gaining kills. Players in these ranks more commonly want to frag-out, and we want the Open League to be the proving grounds of your combat ability. Placement will still be a very effective way to gain RP, kills will just be weighed slightly higher.[/p][p align="start"]The Pro-Am League, on the other hand, will weigh placement higher than kills. We know that our high ranked players want action packed end games, and we want to encourage that by making high placement the best way for these players to gain RP. Plus, as this is the Professional-Ameuteur league, the proportion of total points should be more in line with what the true Apex professionals see in ALGS with highly valuable top-end placement.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]LADDERS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Weekly Ladders are going away as of S32. We’re doing a deep reimagining of what limited-time competition looks like in Apex Legends, and we’ll be talking more about it next year![/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]All of these exciting changes and more, coming in Seasons 31 and 32! We’ll be filling in more details for Season 32 in the lead up to season start, so keep an eye out. And Ranked improvements aren’t stopping at Season 32; make sure to stay tuned for additional updates as the seasons roll on![/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Blood Pact Event
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/1c3b7af66563a4d1fc5bf2d6617cbb568f6904c5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Darkness has descended on Kings Canyon. The Arena now belongs to the forces of darkness, and every Legend is pledging their loyalty to Beasts or Demons. Pick your side to gain infernal abilities or sick werewolf powers, then run wild in a haunted Kings Canyon. Whose side will you join?[/p][h3][b]GO FERAL IN WILDCARD[/b] [/h3][p]Pledge to Beasts or Demons in Wildcard, then earn your faction’s Wild Cards by completing challenges throughout the match. Every round throws down a fresh challenge: if you can deal enough damage or land enough knocks, the Wild Card is yours. Run with the Beasts and complete challenges to become a fast-moving monster, with bonus melee movement speed, faster cells and weapon switching, and temporary critical hits on reload. Or side with the Demons to become an infernal powerhouse, with faster ability recharge, high-tier shields, and full shield recharge with just one cell.[/p][h3][b]STALK A HAUNTED KINGS CANYON[/b] [/h3][p]It all goes down on a spooky Kings Canyon. Fog can randomly descend upon the map, hiding squad movement and reducing sightlines, so the smart hunters use it to stalk their prey. Good thing we dusted off Rev Shell Grenades to seek out whoever’s lurking in the dark. Watch for haunted buildings, glowing Nessies, and scares we’ve stashed across the map: haunted Loot Bins, Pumpkin-skinned EVO orbs, and more.[/p][h3][b]FULL MOON FASHION[/b] [/h3][p]Awoooo! Join the forces of darkness in the Blood Pact Store. Go full 80s werewolf with Sparrow’s new Legend Skin and Character Select Animation, or channel inner demons with Alter’s new Legend Skin and the new R-99 Weapon Skin. Descend into darkness with new Beast and Demon Legend Retheme Bundles, and more.[/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - 10/09/2026
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]Competitive Integrity Update - Weapon Exploit Fixes[/b][/h2][p]We’ve deployed fixes for multiple high-profile weapon exploits in Apex Legends this week. You may have seen the videos circulating in community spaces earlier this week. [/p][p]These fixes address an exploit that allowed an entire magazine to be fired in a single shot, alongside another that enabled rapid firing and reloading with the Sentinel and C.A.R. SMG beyond their intended functionality.[/p][p]These fixes are part of our broader efforts to protect the integrity of Apex Legends. Alongside addressing exploits, we continue to develop and deploy new anti-cheat detections, strengthen existing systems, and take action against players who undermine fair play. This work is ongoing across multiple fronts, even when individual efforts aren't always immediately visible.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update - 10/09/2026
newsitems.author: rspn_jax
newsitems.contents: [p]📋TESTING: We have activated a matchmaking test that increases maximum queue times for Plat+ players on all platforms, in all regions. The queue time increase scales with Rank tier, and Masters players could expect a maximum extension of approximately 30 seconds.[/p][p]This test is in pursuit of tighter skill bands in high skill matches and less spill over of high rank players into mid-rank matches, as the matchmaker spends more time prioritizing the tightest possible lobbies before expanding its search. This test will run until the end of the season, or until we have enough data.[/p][p]Please continue to give feedback on if you are experiencing tighter matchmaking.[/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - 10/08/2026
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[h1][b]First week of EA Javelin Anticheat[/b][/h1][p]Since the transition to EA Javelin Anticheat, we’ve continued to monitor, identify, and disrupt cheating across Apex Legends. The move to Javelin gives our Anti-Cheat team greater visibility into threats and more flexibility to respond as new cheats emerge.[/p][p]We wanted to share an update on what we’ve seen since the transition, including the volume of cheat attempts prevented, enforcement actions taken, and the types of cheating we’ve disrupted. Before diving into the numbers, we should discuss [b][i]cheat prevention[/i][/b]. [/p][p]In the first week following the launch of Javelin Anti-Cheat, [b]265,550[/b] cheating attempts have been prevented before they could impact gameplay.[/p][p]This is an important distinction when looking at anti-cheat numbers. Javelin is designed not only to identify and action cheaters, but to prevent unauthorized software and cheating attempts from functioning in the first place.[/p][p]That means a successful prevention does not always result in a ban — and that is by design.[/p][p]When looking only at enforcement numbers, it can be easy to assume that fewer bans means fewer cheating attempts are being identified. In reality, a significant amount of Javelin's work happens before a cheater ever reaches the point where we need to issue a ban.[/p][p]265,550 prevented attempts represent 265,550 instances where cheating was stopped before it could even have an impact on the game.[/p][p]As we continue to evolve Javelin and expand its coverage, our focus will remain on stopping cheating as early as possible: prevent it when we can, detect it when it gets through, and take action when we have the evidence to do so.[/p][h2][b]Javelin by the Numbers[/b][/h2][p]Week 1 of EA Javelin Anticheat:[/p][list][*][p]265,550 cheat attempts prevented[/p][/*][*][p]12,969 accounts banned[/p][/*][*][p]40 cheat programs tracked[/p][/*][*][p]91% of tracked cheat programs disrupted[/p][/*][/list][p]These numbers represent activity identified and actioned by our Anti-Cheat systems during this period. We’ll continue to monitor these trends as cheat developers adapt and new threats emerge.[/p][h2][b]Enforcement Breakdown[/b][/h2][p]Our enforcement efforts cover a range of cheating methods, including traditional PC cheats as well as third-party hardware and controller-based cheating. While we cannot share a full breakdown of every ban we issue, we can highlight a couple of wins on hardware cheating from the last week:[/p][list][*][p]Aimzenix: 4,058 bans[/p][/*][*][p]Cronus: 1,201 bans[/p][/*][*][p]Titan: 141 bans[/p][/*][*][p]XIM: 199 bans[/p][/*][/list][p]These enforcement actions are based on detections and supporting evidence designed to distinguish cheating behavior from legitimate hardware use.[/p][h2][b]What Comes Next[/b][/h2][p]Despite the early success we’ve found with EA Javelin Anticheat, we are actively investigating videos circulating featuring some pretty egregious cheating activity; more to share soon.[/p][p]Cheating is constantly evolving, and our work doesn’t stop with the transition to Javelin. As new cheat providers, techniques, and devices emerge, we’re continuing to develop and validate new detections and expand our ability to disrupt them.[/p][p]While this anti-cheat update focuses on PC, as EA Javelin Anticheat is a PC system, we will have important updates for console players in the coming weeks.[/p][p]Our goal remains the same: upholding gameplay integrity and ensuring fair play is for everyone.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - 10/01/2026
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]Competitive Integrity Update - Ballistic Exploit Crash[/b][/h2][p]Our Anti-Cheat team recently identified an exploit being used to disrupt matches by intentionally crashing game servers. After thoroughly investigating the suspected perpetrator, we have delivered a permanent account ban, and implemented a fix to the exploit.[/p][p]While investigating a suspected player who appeared to be repeatedly causing lobbies to crash, we identified an exploit involving Ballistic’s Sling passive. The exploit used a modified game client to duplicate a weapon optic far beyond its intended limits. Generating enough duplicated items placed an excessive load on the server, causing the match to become unresponsive and ultimately crash for everyone in the lobby.[/p][p]The player would then reconnect to the match after the crash and attempt to take advantage of other players being disconnected.[/p][p]Once identified, we worked to understand the behavior, confirm the cause, and put a fix in place to prevent this exploit from being used to disrupt matches again.[/p][p]We permanently banned the suspected user and are actioning all accounts found to be using this exploit.[/p][p]We take intentional match disruption seriously. Exploiting vulnerabilities to crash lobbies and interfere with other players' ability to play is unacceptable, and we will continue to investigate reports of this type of behavior and take action when we can confirm abuse.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who reported suspicious lobby crashes and provided information that helped us investigate this issue. Fair play is for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends: Matchmaking Test Results - 09/30/2026
newsitems.author: rspn_jax
newsitems.contents:
[p]For a fully localized version of this post, [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/news/matchmaking-test-results"]please visit here[/url].[/p][h1]INTRO[/h1][p]During our last season, Overclocked, we tested two temporary changes to Ranked matchmaking. Both went after the same thing, something we hear constantly and take seriously: it does not feel good to run into a stacked squad of the game's best players, especially when their Rank feels distant from your own.[/p][p]Ranked Matchmaking only works if you trust it. That means the system has to represent your skill accurately, show you honestly who you are up against, and put you in matches where climbing is possible if you play your best. Apex is a competitive game at its core, and Ranked is where players choose to test that.[/p][p]Below is what we found, and what happens next.[/p][h1]THE PROBLEM WE WENT AFTER[/h1][p]Premade stacks of high-skill players can create bad matches for everyone else, especially in relatively lower-skill lobbies. We see it in the data. Across Ranked, a squad with a premade duo plus a solo fill wins 19% more often than a squad of three solos. A full premade trio wins 17% more often. The behavior concentrates exactly where you would expect: 85% of Masters squads are premade three-stacks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/0a207df633e2240ae339177c8f0e73b848120f9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Both tests were aimed at tackling the problem of premade squad advantages.[/p][h1]THE TWO TESTS[/h1][p][b]Test 1, premade tier restriction.[/b] You could still squad up, but only with players within one tier of you instead of two. The goal was to stop wide-band squads from dragging lower-tier players into high-tier lobbies.[/p][p][b]Test 2, solo queue only.[/b] Diamond, Master, and Predator players were locked to solo queue. No premades at all at the top end of play.[/p][p]For both tests, we wanted to measure two things: whether match quality actually improved, and how the change felt to play. The second matters as much as the first, and it is the one we can only answer by hearing what you tell us.[/p][h1]TEST 1: THE TIER RESTRICTION CHANGED LITTLE FOR A SMALL GROUP OF PLAYERS[/h1][p]Diamond players faced about 8% fewer Diamond opponents and roughly 8% more Platinum opponents. Platinum players saw more Diamonds in their lobbies. Outside those two tiers, nothing meaningful changed.[/p][p]A small improvement for a narrow slice of players was not worth the constraint on everyone else who was used to playing with friends within two rank tiers from them. As a result, at this time, we are not making the one-tier restriction permanent.[/p][h1]TEST 2: SOLO QUEUE WORKED MECHANICALLY, BUT IT DID NOT DELIVER AN IMPROVED EXPERIENCE[/h1][p]Premade three-stacks at the top of the ladder went away but the rest did not go the way we hoped.[/p][h1][b]Who wins did not change[/b][/h1][p]If removing premades squads results in more even matches, we would expect the distance between the strongest squads in a lobby and everyone else to shrink. Coordination is an advantage that RP does not measure, so taking it away should have pulled the top of the lobby back to a more even playing field. [/p][p]Unfortunately, this number barely moved. In Diamond, match result distributions stayed roughly where they were. In Masters we saw a small dip in the top squads' win rate, but the win-rate gap between the top 10 and the bottom 10 teams held at 9%. The best squad in the lobby still wins, whether or not they queued together.[/p][h1][b]Exposure to top players got worse, not better[/b][/h1][p]This is the result we did not expect, and it is the most useful thing we learned.[/p][p]First, a brief overview of how a Ranked squad gets built. The matchmaker pulls 60 available players of similar RP into a lobby, sorts everyone by RP, and splits that list into thirds. Each squad gets one player from the top third, one from the middle, and one from the bottom. That is how it tries to keep teams even.[/p][p]When we took away the ability for Masters and above to squad up, most of them did not leave the lobby. They were distributed one per squad instead of clustering into a few, which means more squads in more matches contained a top-tier player. We broke up the stacks and spread them across the board.[/p][p]For a Diamond player, that reads as more matches with a Master or Predator in them than before.[/p][p]It also looked worse than it was on our pre-match skill display. A squad with one Masters player and a squad with three Predators currently show up identically. So when more players ran into solo high-tier players more often, the result was more red on screen before the match even started. [/p][p]This is the typical shift that was visible to players. These two games have exactly the same distribution of opponents (6 Predators, 36 Masters, and 18 Diamonds).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/3ead92b44771e3aa88edd7e131cceb91deca0720.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/9649b28dd8685d1da8ab8b0f55a8f16f5a18b085.png"][/img]
We are going to continue to iterate on this display. [/p][h1]Ranked play dropped among the players who play Ranked socially[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/4f15a9fb31fc1b48e88b41e4743c5d30d0ad7990.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Return rate here measures how many players came back to Apex during the test after playing in the days right before it. The weakest numbers were in Diamond and above cohorts who had been playing in duos and trios. These were not casual players drifting off. They were some of the most engaged players we have, and their Ranked play fell off during the window.[/p][p]That is ultimately the part of the test we cannot accept. Ranked matchmaking gets better when there are more players at every skill level in the queue. More players means tighter bands, shorter waits, and closer matches for everybody. Any change that pushes people out of Ranked worsens the thing we were actively trying to fix. This test was meant to improve the Ranked experience. Instead it thinned out Ranked. That is a bad trade.[/p][h1]Where we landed[/h1][p]We are not rolling out the solo queue experiment as a permanent requirement for high-skill lobbies. That does not mean solo queue experiments are dead. It means this version was too broad.[/p][p]What we are carrying forward is the goal without the blunt instrument: reduce how often you run into fully coordinated top-tier squads, without taking away your ability to play with your friends.[/p][h1]WHAT IS NEXT[/h1][p]Our teams continue to prepare various tests to continue to address matchmaking pain points, the details of which we’ll share as we get closer to implementation. The biggest upcoming changes that are coming as a result of these recent tests will be landing in Ranked in Seasons 31 and 32; we look forward to sharing those changes in October.[/p][h1]IN CLOSING[/h1][p]Apex is a competitive game at its core, and the best possible experience for our whole player base comes when we have players at every skill level playing Ranked. It is the mechanism by which matchmaking gets better for everyone.[/p][p]Thank you for playing through these tests with us, and for sharing your feedback throughout. Keep an eye out for Ranked changes to come in the next few seasons![/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: EA Javelin Anticheat is Coming to Apex Legends
newsitems.author: rspn_jax
newsitems.contents: [p]For a fully localized version of the following, [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/news/javelin-anticheat-announcement"]please visit the official blog page[/url].[/p][h1]Intro[/h1][p]Effective September 29th, 2026, Apex Legends will be switching its PC anticheat system to EA Javelin Anticheat. We extend our deepest gratitudes to the Easy Anti Cheat team at Epic Games for a long and fruitful partnership. Moving to EA Javelin Anticheat will give our anticheat teams greater visibility into emerging threats and more flexibility to develop and improve detections as cheating evolves. This is an important step aligned with our priority to establish and maintain a high standard of competitive integrity in the Apex games.[/p][h1]EA Javelin Anticheat[/h1][p]EA Javelin Anticheat is a PC anticheat solution designed to ensure fair play in EA games by preventing and detecting cheating while focusing on privacy and security. The goal is for players to have a level playing field where results, progression and success are determined purely by merit. This gives our players a more secure experience, preventing cheaters from impacting others’ gameplay, security and privacy.[/p][p]On titles that currently use EA Javelin Anticheat, the solution has prevented millions of cheating attempts while maintaining an [url="https://www.ea.com/news/ea-javelin-anticheat-2026-update"]accuracy rate of over 99%[/url].[/p][p]Read more about EA Javelin Anticheat [url="https://www.ea.com/news/introducing-ea-javelin-anticheat"]here[/url].[/p][h1]What to Expect[/h1][p]When this feature goes live on September 29th, PC players will be prompted to download a game update. After the update completes, launch Apex Legends and you’ll automatically be migrated to EA Javelin Anticheat – simple as that! [/p][p]Some players may be familiar with EA Javelin Anticheat from other EA titles and might remember a component requiring them to navigate bios menus on their PC to enable secure boot. At this time, that is [b][i]not[/i][/b] the case for Apex Legends; simply download, install, launch, and play.[/p][h1]Console Anticheat[/h1][p]While this update highlights our core PC protection layer, maintaining game integrity is a multi-platform priority. We continue to actively invest in specialized data models and server-side detection methods targeted at console-specific cheats. Bringing our anti-cheat engineering, telemetry, and data capabilities together in-house gives our teams greater speed and visibility, sharpening our ability to curb cheating across the entire landscape.[/p][h1]Outro[/h1][p]This is an important step for Apex Legends as we continue to invest in creating the best possible competitive experience for our players. We will continue to develop our anticheat tools to achieve a high standard of competitive integrity and will continue to provide updates as they become available. To stay up-to-date on the latest anti-cheat updates, be sure to follow ApexLiveComms on [url="https://x.com/apexlivecomms"]X[/url] and [url="https://threads.com/apexlivecomms"]Threads[/url].[/p]

newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[h1][b]Competitive Integrity Update — Account Sharing[/b][/h1][p]We’ve taken action against players who were found to be sharing their accounts across multiple devices to gain an unfair advantage on the Apex Predator leaderboard.[/p][p]Following reports from the community of Predator players maintaining unusually long, continuous Ranked play sessions, our Anti-Cheat team reviewed login activity and device data associated with high-ranked accounts. This investigation identified accounts being accessed from multiple distinct devices in a manner consistent with account sharing, specifically targeting console users.[/p][p]As a result, we have handed 258 Predator players 60-day suspensions across PlayStation and Xbox.[/p][h3][b]Enforcement Breakdown[/b][/h3][p][b]PlayStation — 115 players[/b][/p][list][*][p]92 players were found to be frequently sharing their accounts[/p][/*][*][p]2 players were found to be sharing their accounts across 5+ devices[/p][/*][*][p]21 players frequently shared & shared with 5+devices[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Xbox — 143 players[/b][/p][list][*][p]124 players were found to be frequently sharing their accounts[/p][/*][*][p]2 players were found to be sharing their accounts across 5+ devices[/p][/*][*][p]17 players frequently shared & shared with 5+devices[/p][/*][/list][p]Account sharing is prohibited under our Terms of Service and undermines the integrity of Ranked play. Accounts found to be participating in account sharing will be suspended, and all associated Ranked points will be removed.

We’ll continue monitoring Ranked play and taking action against accounts that attempt to gain an unfair advantage through account sharing or other forms of abuse.[/p][p]Ranked integrity matters, and the Predator leaderboard should reflect the players who actually earned their position.[/p][h3][b]Bot Royale False Ban Reports[/b][/h3][p]We’ve also seen reports from the community claiming that recent enforcement actions were the result of players being incorrectly banned while playing Bot Royale.[/p][p]We reviewed these reports, including the accounts brought forward by the community, and conducted additional validation of the associated enforcement. newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[h2][b]INTRO[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome back to Split 2 of Apex Legends: Marked. To start the second half of the season, we’ve got Legend balancing changes, some adjustment to loot availability (including more healing items), buffs to a trio of long range weapons, and the usual array of tweaks, fixes and adjustments. Split 2 starts on September 15th, so assemble your squad and get ready to jump back into Marked![/p][h2][b]ANTI CHEAT UPDATE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In the leadup to Split 2, we implemented significant, new systems to detect players using unauthorized controller hardware or software in Apex Legends on all platforms including: PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2.[/p][p align="start"]Prior to implementation, we spent several months thoroughly validating these systems to ensure they can accurately identify prohibited behavior. Players that trigger these detections will be actioned upon and may be banned accordingly upon review. Playing on console does not make you exempt from detection or enforcement.[/p][p align="start"]This is just the beginning for these new systems which we will continue to improve to keep pace with evolving cheating methods.[/p][p align="start"]We want the community to know that we are actively working to identify and remove cheaters at every level of play — including the highest ranks. Thank you to everyone who reports suspicious behavior and helps us keep Apex Legends fair. [/p][p align="start"]For more anti-cheat information, check out our most recent [url="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://x.com/ApexLiveComms/status/2095200405651386605&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1788924364889438&usg=AOvVaw0l7gb_zQRktvDYCbeR8N06"]update[/url]![/p][h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1][h2][b]LEGEND BUFFS[/b][/h2][h3][b]Conduit[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Our main goal is to give Conduit players more avenues for skill expression and to ensure her abilities feel functional, readable, and fluid. Apex’s Shield Healer saw a big uptick in her success throughout Season 29 thanks to some overhauls to her Tactical and its associated upgrades. Despite Conduit receiving a few nerfs since then, we still wanted to come back to her this Season to focus on polishing and refining her Ultimate, as mentioned in the Season 29 Designer’s Notes. Beyond her base kit, we wanted to give Conduit two brand new Level 2 Upgrades that are now fully unique to her and emphasize different aspects of her aggressive support style.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added preview visuals on the shield bar to indicate how much Temp Shield will be generated by the end of the regen period.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Various aspects of the Ultimate’s deployment have been smoothed out, meaning it fires faster and gets you back to guns sooner.[/p][/*][*][p]Can now toggle orientation while targeting to deploy jammers in a forward line.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new HUD element to better inform players if their deployment location will cause jammers to break.[/p][list][*][p]Also, individual jammer indicators now turn red if they would break at the current targeting location.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jammers now spawn higher and slightly closer together, creating a tighter formation that covers more vertical space.[/p][/*][*][p]Jammers activate significantly faster, establishing the barricade’s threat area quicker.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Both Level 2 Upgrades, Battpack and Bigger Jam, have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW:[/b] Concurrency (Level 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Refire Energy Barricade once with no cooldown within 10s of initial firing.[/p][/*][*][p]Jammers spawn in a tighter formation with 2 less jammers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW:[/b] Jammed Up (Level 2)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Energy Barricade’s jammers have a 25% larger radius and enemies damaged by them have their HUD jammed for 10s.[/p][h3][b]Fuse[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Though this grenadier has seen a gradual increase in play over time since his rework in Season 28, we wanted to revisit him to address the community feedback that we didn’t hit the efficacy, impact, and responsiveness expected of a new Motherlode. We’re also making some big shakeups to his Upgrade configuration that impact the rest of his kit, including incorporating Wreckless and Knuckle Cluster into his base kit (with some nerfs). Rest assured, we’ll be keeping a close eye on him, as our intention is to add more hype tech to Fuse’s toolbox without pushing him toward being a Legend defined by his movement. He will always be Apex’s explosives expert first and foremost![/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 25% Explosive Damage Resistance at base and can see ordinances highlighted in the world within 30m of him.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fuse can now Knuckle Jump at base.[/p][list][*][p]Jumping no longer provides Tactical cooldown reduction.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump power moderately decreased, so Fuse will gain less momentum when jumping.[/p][/*][*][p]Now displays a visual indicator that signifies the radius where the jump can be activated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Significantly decreased the time it takes to return to guns after firing.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now ADS while aiming to zoom.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slightly decreased the raise time.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the firing arc with the focus on the main explosive projectile landing more quickly and responsively.[/p][list][*][p]Added an indicator to visualize the radius of the initial and subsequent explosions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Decreased the time it takes for the mini-bombs to explode, speeding up the rollout of explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the damage falloff on the initial explosion, meaning enemies closer to the edge of the radius will take a higher percentage of the maximum damage.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Knuckle Jumper (Level 2) and Wreckless (Level 3) have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Reignition has been moved from Level 3 to Level 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Pyro Techniques (Level 2)[/p][list][*][p]Doubled the radius of the persistent flames.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reignition (Level 2)[/p][list][*][p]Decreased Ultimate Recharge Rate from 1s per 2 explosive damage to 1s per 3 explosive damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]NEW:[/b] Big Bang (Level 3)[/p][list][*][p]Knuckle Cluster’s explosions cover a 50% larger area.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]NEW:[/b] Sticky Bomb (Level 3)[/p][list][*][p]Knuckle Cluster’s initial projectile is 25% larger and sticks to enemies. Every 7 hits on an enemy reduces Knuckle Cluster’s cooldown by 1s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Catalyst[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Catalyst saw a small boost in pick rate after her buffs in Season 28, but we felt she needed more love using a slightly different approach since her stats didn’t hold. This Season, we’re focusing more holistically on smoothing out the tension of moving from base to base amongst the fast pace of action. We want Cat’s building experience to be fun and flexible, so giving her more options to customize her space and adding in some longtime community-requested quality-of-life features will empower players to feel rewarded for putting in the work to master her. We’re also making big swings on shuffling up her upgrades, including a new Level 3 upgrade, Ferro-Frenzy, that will really shake up how we see players approach their setup.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]Catalyst is no longer immune to other Catalysts’ abilities.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now automatically reinforces or rebuilds doors if colliding with a valid door or doorway on placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Cooldown from 20s to 15s.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Spike Height, meaning that players can less easily jump over them. [/p][/*][*][p]Hitting enemies with the projectile will now deal damage to them.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Significantly decreased firing time, making it smoother to deploy and raise the wall.[/p][/*][*][p]Allies are no longer slowed or blinded when passing through the wall.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sole Piercer (Level 2) has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Hidden Spikes has been moved from Level 2 to Level 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Resilient Veil and Ferro-Door have been moved from Level 3 to Level 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Ferro-Door (Level 2)[/p][list][*][p]Now also increases max reinforced doors from 4 to 6.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Resilient Veil (Level 2)[/p][list][*][p]Now also decreases Ultimate Cooldown from 150s to 120s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]NEW:[/b] Ferro-Frenzy (Level 3)[/p][list][*][p]Your max Spike count is increased by 1. Spikes are 50% smaller, but deal faster tick damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Bloodhound[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Bloodhound got some significant changes for this season but they haven’t been as impactful on their pick and encounter win rates as we hoped. With these updates we’re hoping to add some improvements to their Ultimate and Tactical. We’ll continue to monitor Bloodhound’s performance and adjust if needed.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b][i]From 8/25 Hotfix:[/i][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced cloak visibility while in dome.[/p][/*][*][p]Ring damage no longer drops cloak.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 1 extra second on scan length.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked to provide more frequent snapshots, but the snapshots fade over time. [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b][i]New:[/i][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sonar snapshots begin fading more quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Sonar snapshots should disappear more readily when seeing the head of either the snapshot or the player being tracked.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]LEGEND NERFS[/b][/h2][h3][b]Axle[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: For an ability with a short cooldown that can have a devastating effect on one target, the Kickstart drone needs more counterplay options. Even when the victim decides to destroy the drone, the high health pool often makes that hard to do, especially in close quarters when Axle is quickly following up, herself. For cases when destroying it isn’t an option, at least the victim should be able to have more agency about where they get displaced with the knockback nerf and decreased stun.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b][i]From 8/25 Hotfix:[/i][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Nitro Gate launch speed reduced from 750 to 700.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ultimate HP reduced from 200 to 150.[/p][/*][*][p]Base Ultimate cooldown increased from 90s to 120s.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimate knockback arc widened and max height reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimate stun duration reduced from 1.5s to 0.25s.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Jump Gate replaced with a new Drone Deployer Upgrade that brings the Ult cooldown back down to 90s.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Seer[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: The turn slow punishment on the Seer tactical was very frustrating to fight against. We’ve decided to remove the turn slow since the tactical output is still strong without it.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b][i]From 8/25 Hotfix:[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed turn slow when hit by the Tactical [/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]LOOT & ATTACHMENTS[/b][/h2][h3][b]LOOT SPAWNING[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Last season, we made a huge change to loot distribution and spawning (read our retrospective in this update’s designer’s notes!). After reviewing the data and feedback from the community, we are making some minor adjustments to healing, ammo, and weapon availability. Healing was becoming scarcer than intended, and due to the removal of energy ammo, the other ammo types were spawning ammo boxes at higher rates than intended.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Bin Resets have been adjusted to be closer to its pre-Season 30 version but keeps the original intent of reducing its overall spike to player power. The Season 30 version was not providing the density of necessities needed to quickly re-stock for the end game. Reset Bins now have more items on average with healing, ammo, survival slot items, and amps spawning more frequently inside.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]The Weapon Assist feature previously only included a small selection of pistols, shotguns and the Alternator. To help players find higher quality weapons off the drop, we are expanding this to now include all available weapons.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]These adjustments help to address some of the pain points we have been seeing while maintaining the overall goal of last update’s changes of creating an overall healthier loot curve as the game progresses.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]We will continue to monitor your feedback and make adjustments as quickly as we can![/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Loot Pool Spawn Rates (Pre-Bin Reset)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased availability of healing items.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased availability of ammo.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Loot Bin Reset[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased average count of items spawned per bin[/p][/*][*][p]Increased availability of:[/p][list][*][p]Healing[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Slot items[/p][/*][*][p]Amps[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Loot Bin Logic[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated loot bin logic to significantly reduce the possibility of empty loot bins spawning in game.[/p][/*][*][p]The weapon pool for Weapon Assist (opening your first loot bin of the match while having no weapons in your inventory) now has the chance to spawn all base weapons.[/p][list][*][p]Previously could only spawn a selection of pistols, shotguns, and the Alternator.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]WEAPONS[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Season 30 was a large shakeup to the weapon meta and we want to let things settle a bit more before making any big changes. Now, both he and Maggie should move as intended with their respective movement speed buffs and the Agile Standard Stock.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b](Previously Hotfixed) Agile Standard Stock \[Corrupted][/b][/p][list][*][p]The movement speed increase no longer stacks with:[/p][list][*][p]Maggie's Warlord's Ire passive[/p][/*][*][p]Maggie's Gunrunning legend upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Gibraltar's Fast Shotties legend upgrade[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]LOCKED HOP-UPS[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Heavy hitting shotguns can be inconsistent with their damage, either with chunky hits or lots of 11s. As such, it can be more difficult to unlock their respective hop-ups when compared to a full auto-weapon. Thus we are lowering the cost to unlock.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Executioner[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced cost to unlock from 375 to 275.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]MAPS[/b][/h2][p align="start"][i]Dev note: In this patch, we’re rolling out over 150 map-related Quality of Life fixes across the Outlands with a massive chunk of that polish going straight to World’s Edge. We’ve smoothed out sticky collisions to keep wall-bouncing and rotations fluid, patched up geo holes that were occasionally swallowing loot and Legends, and permanently closed off several unintended rat spots to maintain competitive integrity. Alongside these tweaks we’ve also cleaned up some clipping issues related to Alter’s Ultimate.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Massive shoutout to our community for continuing to report these back to the team. Finding every hole, ledge or rat spot across the Outlands is a huge undertaking and the clips and bug reports you share are exactly what helps us track them down. Your feedback directly shapes the map health of Apex so keep sharing your clips.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Pubs Map Rotation[/b][/p][list][*][p]World’s Edge[/p][/*][*][p]Olympus[/p][/*][*][p]Broken Moon[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ranked Map Rotation[/b][/p][list][*][p]World’s Edge[/p][/*][*][p]Olympus[/p][/*][*][p]Broken Moon[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Mixtape[/b][/p][list][*][p]9/15/26 - 11/3/26[/p][list][*][p]TDM: Fragment, Skull Town, Monument, Estates[/p][/*][*][p]Control: Production Yard, Labs, Barometer, Caustic[/p][/*][*][p]Gun Run: Monument, Estates, Fragment, Skull Town[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]WILDCARD[/b][/h2][p align="start"][b]Wildcard Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]EVO gained when no weapons are equipped will now grant that EVO towards progression on the first weapon you equip.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Map Rotation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Kings Canyon Wildcard [/p][/*][*][p]Olympus Wildcard [/p][/*][*][p]District Wildcard[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]RANKED[/b][/h2][p align="start"][b]Ranked Ladders (coming later this split)[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][th][p][b]Ladder 1[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]9/‌22/‌2026[/b][/p][/th][th][p][b]9/‌27/‌2026[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Ladder 2[/b][/p][/td][td][p]9/‌29/‌2026[/p][/td][td][p]10/‌4/‌2026[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Ladder 3[/b][/p][/td][td][p]10/‌6/‌2026[/p][/td][td][p]10/‌11/‌2026[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Ladder 4[/b][/p][/td][td][p]10/‌13/‌2026[/p][/td][td][p]10/‌18/‌2026[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Ladder 5[/b][/p][/td][td][p]10/‌20/‌2026[/p][/td][td][p]10/‌25/‌2026[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Ladder 6[/b][/p][/td][td][p]10/‌27/‌2026[/p][/td][td][p]11/‌1/‌2026[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]AUDIO[/b][/h2][p align="start"][i]Dev note: We understand how crucial game audio can be to the outcome of a fight or match. newsitems.title: Controller Anti-Cheat Enforcement & Ban Wave Update — 09/02/2026
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[p]We are implementing significant, new systems to detect players using unauthorized controller hardware or software in Apex Legends on all platforms including: PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2.[/p][p]We’ve spent the past several months thoroughly validating these systems to ensure they can accurately identify prohibited behavior.[/p][p]Players that trigger these detections will be actioned upon and banned accordingly.[/p][p]If you are using controller modifications, devices, or software to gain an unfair advantage, now is the time to stop. Playing on console does not make you exempt from detection or enforcement.[/p][p]This is just the beginning of these new systems which we will continue to improve to keep pace with evolving cheating methods.[/p][p]Additionally, we’ve continued to update and strengthen our existing anti-cheat systems this season, with new detections and enforcement targeting a range of cheating methods, including a pesky new cheat provider.[/p][p]In our latest ban wave, over the past 7 days alone (at the time of writing this):
• 8,609 players were banned for cheating
• 290 DMA-related bans
• 76 Titan Controller bans
• 267 bans tied to a newly detected cheat provider[/p][p]Over the past two weeks:
• 96 Predator-level players banned across all platforms[/p][p]We continue to see improvements in our match infection rate. It has decreased to 3.9% down from 5.7% at the beginning of the season.[/p][p]These numbers represent only a snapshot of our ongoing enforcement efforts. Our Anti-Cheat team continues to develop, test, and deploy new detections while improving our ability to identify emerging threats.[/p][p]We want the community to know that we are actively working to identify and remove cheaters at every level of play — including the highest ranks. Thank you to everyone who reports suspicious behavior and helps us keep Apex Legends fair. [/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends™: Marked
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents: [h3]This season, Bloodhound evolves into the ultimate predator, World’s Edge shifts with new POIs, and Corrupted Attachments arm every squad for the hunt. The gods are watching, prove you deserve their favor. [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/86df38bb82a94f5de3e192627baa6ad02085ff1e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The Hunter of Legends[/b] [/p][p]Blessed by the Allfather, Bloodhound evolves from skilled tracker to lethal hunter. Follow the trail with an improved Passive, keep prey in sight with longer Tactical scans, and strike from the shadows with the new Allfather’s Cloak Ultimate. [/p][p][b]Fresh Hunting Grounds[/b] [/p][p]World’s Edge shifts, bringing new hunting grounds, old-god aesthetics, and aurora borealis glowing in the night sky. Stalk your prey through 3 new POIs: East Village and its massive Longhouse, the War Camp arena, and the towering Tree Settlement. Old favorites return too: Sorting Factory is back and Stacks re-emerges in Fragment. [/p][p][b]The Weapon Chooses the Hunter[/b] [/p][p]Your loadout walks the line between predator and prey. Corrupted Attachments introduce new late-game power with a real tradeoff, while visible weapon stats show exactly how each attachment changes your gun. Streamlined loot bins make looting faster and simpler: spend less time perfecting your loadout and more time using it. [/p][p][b]The Pack Grows Stronger[/b] [/p][p]Loba keeps the squad supplied with a faster Tactical and an improved Black Market, which now has a quicker cooldown and drops EVO Orbs. Rampart bolsters the defense, moving faster while firing Sheila and building tougher walls in less time. [/p][p][b]Chosen by the Gods[/b] [/p][p]A true weapon of the gods. The Allfather’s Fury Mythic CAR channels the power of the old gods, and has 5 customization tiers unlockable with Exotic Shards. Available as a possible drop in the Marked Seasonal Pack. [/p][p][b]Claim Your Trophies[/b] [/p][p]Go hunt with the Marked Premium Battle Pass. Earn Legendary skins for Bloodhound and Caustic, a Legendary Mozambique Weapon Skin, 10 Exotic Shards, and the Reactive R-301 at Tier 60. [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends™: Marked Patch Notes
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]INTRO[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome to the latest season of Apex Legends: MARKED. In addition to Bloodhound’s rework, buffs to Loba and Rampart, an energy weapon systems overhaul, and brand new Corrupted Attachments, we’re also bringing you a World’s Edge map rework, quality of life tweaks, and a slew of balancing changes. All of this is in pursuit of evolving Apex Legends into the best, most competitive Battle Royale out there. This season is going to push you and your squad to be the best you can possibly be, so get ready to group up, gear up, and dive into MARKED when it drops on August 4th, 2026![/p][h2][b]MATCHMAKING TESTS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 29, we ran two matchmaking tests — 1-Tier Premade Restrictions and Diamond+ Solo-Queue-Only — to experiment with variables to potentially use to address player frustrations in Ranked. Thank you to everyone who engaged with the tests and for the feedback you provided; it’s integral to helping us shape the future of the game mode. We are actively analyzing and evaluating the data from these tests, and are in the process of writing an upcoming blog to discuss the results and next steps. Keep an eye out for the followup comms in the coming weeks.[/p][h2][b]SERVER STABILITY[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We've beefed up our servers in Season 30. While not everyone will notice the difference, many players should experience increased stability, less lag, and lower chances of slo-mo servers across all game modes and regions. We're always working to improve the competitive experience for our players and, while these changes often take place behind the scenes, we’re excited to provide a noteworthy improvement for you all![/p][h2][b]GAME UPDATES[/b][/h2][h3][b]World’s Edge[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: We feel World’s Edge is in a solid place competitively, and have seen the sentiments echoed throughout the community, so our focus in updating the map was reducing disparity between POIs and delivering on players’ frequently requested changes, such as the return of Sorting Factory and Construction Stacks. To complement Bloodhound’s rework, we leveraged the new POIs in this update to move Bloodhound’s story forward in a meaningful way.[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]East Village[/b][/p][list][*][p]East Village: Added additional rock and tree cover in open areas around the POI[/p][/*][*][p]East Village: Modified the terrain at the base of the Dam for less punishing traversal[/p][/*][*][p]East Village: Added additional ziplines to access the Dam rotating from East Village (previously Climatizer)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tree Settlement[/b] replaces The Tree[/p][/*][*][p][b]War Camp[/b] replaces Survey Camp[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sorting Factory[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sorting Factory: Added a central connection to the train tunnel to keep this rotation from Lava Siphon[/p][/*][*][p]Sorting Factory: Modified platforms to keep Lava Siphon's bridge leading to Fragment East[/p][/*][*][p]Sorting Factory: Added a new tunnel and vertical zipline connection to enter the POI from the southwest near Tree Settlement[/p][/*][*][p]Sorting Factory: Added new platforms and ziplines around each train tunnel exit for smoother traversal[/p][/*][*][p]Sorting Factory: Added new train cars on the tracks in the station building[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Monument/Fragment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Monument/Fragment: Restored the stacks/construction building at Fragment West to spread out combat at Fragment[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Landslide[/b][/p][list][*][p]Landslide: Merged Big Maude with Landslide to improve viability as a landing location[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Stacks/Lava City: Restored the original camp that existed before Big Maude and placed additional cover nearby[/p][/*][*][p]Stacks/Lava City: Placed additional platforms and buildings around the outskirts of the POI to improve rotations and endgames[/p][/*][*][p]Countdown: Improved quality of loot in the underground vault[/p][/*][*][p]Harvester: Adjusted collision on the angled rooftops of the long modular buildings to prevent slipping[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a large amount of bugs, rat spots and navigational issues[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Map Rotations[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: To maximize the spotlight on the World’s Edge glow up, and to give you an opportunity to better familiarize yourself with the changes, we are modifying the map rotations within the first week of the season, after which it will return to the map rotation listed below.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Tuesday August 4th[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ranked:[/b] World’s Edge for 24 hours, then back to normal 4.5 hour rotation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pubs:[/b] World’s Edge for 24 hours, then back to normal 90 minutes rotation[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Saturday August 8th - Sunday August 9th[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ranked[/b]: World’s Edge for 48 hours, then back to normal 4.5 hour rotation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pubs:[/b] No change, normal 90 minutes rotation[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Pubs & Ranked[/b][/p][list][*][p]World’s Edge[/p][/*][*][p]Storm Point[/p][/*][*][p]E-District[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Mixtape[/b] [/p][list][*][p]8/4/26 - 9/15/26[/p][list][*][p]TDM: Fragment East, Skull Town, Monument, Estates[/p][/*][*][p]Control: Caustic, Labs, Barometer, Labs[/p][/*][*][p]Gun Run: Monument, Estates, Fragment, Skull Town[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Wildcard[/b][/p][list][*][p]8/4/26 - 9/15/26[/p][list][*][p]Kings Canyon Wildcard[/p][/*][*][p]E-District Wildcard [/p][/*][*][p]Divided Moon Wildcard [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Revamped Power Journey[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Over the lifetime of Apex, Looting has changed substantially. A rising problem we wanted to address with these changes was the loot inflation and ease that players have around finding very high quality loot. In many cases, progressing through a match could feel like a quick spike at the beginning or mid point of the match and quite flat afterwards.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]We’ve overhauled several systems that were added over the past few years to shape a more engaging and straightforward loot chase for players. The spawn rates of high tier loot have been reduced across all maps, meaning that finding a rare Attachment will be a ‘rarer’ occurrence, and will signal a real shift in the power of your weapon.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Arsenals provide a consistent way to get the guns you want, but can disrupt the game start by luring players into hot drop contests in the open spaces around Arsenals. Arsenals are now time locked, similar to EVO Harvesters. This ensures that they are available early game when you want them, but that your earliest fights off the drop are supplied only by what you can loot from the map.
