newsitems.contents: [h2][b]TL;DR[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Below, we’ll provide insight into meta changes coming in our next season, Marked.  We’ll discuss our goals and rationale for the changes for each of the following:[/p][list][*][p]Bloodhound’s Rework[/p][/*][*][p]Loba’s Buff[/p][/*][*][p]Rampart’s Buff[/p][/*][*][p]Valkyrie’s Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Axle’s Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Seer’s Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon UI Stats Overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]NEW Corrupted Attachments[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped Power Journey[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]INTRODUCTION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome to Designer’s  Notes for our next season - MARKED. We appreciate all the time you spent playing in the most recent season, and the feedback that you’ve provided. Using your feedback and our internal match data, we have been hard at work, tuning and adjusting to get ready for our next update.[/p][p align="start"]This season we are excited to bring a much anticipated update to Bloodhound. We know there has been a lot of chatter about giving them a refresh and we are finally ready to reveal all the hard work that has gone into making Bloodhound a more competitively viable pick amongst the Legend roster. However, Bloodhound isn’t the only Legend getting updates. We have incoming buffs for Rampart and Loba to help make them more attractive picks, and changes to Valkyrie, Seer, and Axle to assuage some player frustrations.[/p][p align="start"]We have [i]significant[/i] changes coming to weapons and loot this season. We’ve refreshed our weapon and attachment UI to better help you understand the effects of each potential piece in your arsenal. Speaking of attachments, we are adding a new wave of attachments called “Corrupted Attachments.” These attachments have powerful buffs, but also noteworthy drawbacks. We are looking to create interesting risk-reward choices around the attachment meta and we’re excited to see how you leverage them in your in-game strategy.[/p][p align="start"]In another big change: we are removing energy ammo from the loot pool. That’s right, energy weapons will now regenerate their ammo. This was done in an effort to create a unique way of playing with energy weapons and to give you more options for how you decide to manage your backpack. With this change, we are looking to provide more variety of choice and player expression, and want to see how you integrate this new system into your squad’s strategy.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for all the time you spend playing Apex. We appreciate all the feedback you give and look forward to hearing from you on what you think of our latest update. See you in the dropship![/p][h1][b]LEGEND BUFFS[/b][/h1][h2][b]BLOODHOUND REWORK[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Back in Season 28, we brought in a package of buffs to help Bloodhound’s pick rate while we worked on some bigger changes intended to make Bloodhound a more viable pick at all skill levels.  Despite those changes, Bloodhound remains nearly invisible at middle-to-high tiers; they have the lowest pick rate once you get to Gold tier and above. It’s been a long time coming, but we’ve made substantial changes to each ability in their kit to help you truly live out the true hunter fantasy.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5u549qZkVAGqQmQHFJvjxC/b745b2f01cca3bf23388aeaab8048c31/01_Plat__Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Bloodhound_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Plat+ Ranked gameplay from 11-1-2025 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][h3][b]Passive[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Bloodhound’s passive creates lingering trails behind enemies that you can follow to track and eliminate your opponents. You can also activate your White Ravens more easily by glancing at them for a short time.[/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Bloodhound’s Tactical now shows additional “snapshot” scans after the initial scan finishes, increasing the amount of time you can track enemy locations (without being a full wallhack). [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Bloodhound is boasting a brand new Ultimate: Allfather’s Cloak. Activating their Ult will deploy a device that cloaks everyone — squadmates and enemies — who approaches it. The cloak persists for 12 seconds after leaving the Ult’s space and breaks after using your weapons or taking damage. While you aren’t [i]fully[/i] invisible, you are much harder to see and track, allowing you to set ambushes for enemy squads or escape tricky situations.  [/p][h3][b]New Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Hidden Sight:[/b] refreshes your Tactical when you use your Ultimate, and hides your scanning pulse from enemies while cloaked allowing you to survey the scene without notifying enemies to your whereabouts[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bird’s Eye:[/b] allows your White Ravens to split off and mark two different enemies at the same time, identifying your two nearest threats[/p][/*][*][p][b]True Predator:[/b] allows you to recloak after firing your weapon, enhancing your ability to hit-and-run after using your Ultimate.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]LOBA[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Loba’s loot-oriented kit has seen her popularity decline over time, particularly as amps and arsenals provide other ways to build healthy loadouts. While we expect Loba’s usefulness to rise with the loot changes coming in season 30 (more on that below), it still felt like she could use additional buffs to help keep her relevant.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6LLKtz5YC6Z9gEEXkVTkqa/4e93b3bc63888896709d303843642386/03_Overall_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Loba_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.34296875,yPosition=0.4949074074074074" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay from 10-1-2024 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The main change we’re making to Loba is reducing how long it takes to deploy her Tactical. - We’re reducing the activation time from 0.6s to 0.4s, increasing the projectile speed by ~30% so it lands more quickly, and adding a 15% range increase.  [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To make Loba’s Ult a bit more alluring, we’re shaving some time off of its cooldown, bringing it down from 150s to 120s, to help your squad stay ahead of other squads in terms of resources as the game progresses.[/p][h2][b]RAMPART[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Despite significant changes in Season 27, Rampart remains near the bottom of pick rate graphs at every skill level. While she can be particularly powerful in late-game when set up in a great spot, her setup still feels slow and she’s too challenging to play throughout most of a match. As such, we have a handful of changes we’re making to hopefully pull up her pick rate a bit.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1HzdGoLCKv3vUophCPK4An/2009ced73df35fce56475390bb62e8ab/02_Overall_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Rampart_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.28854166666666664,yPosition=0.4847222222222222" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][h3][b]Passive[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Rampart is gaining a new element to her Battle Modder passive: she progresses Locked Hop-Ups 50% faster to unlock more powerful weapons earlier in the match.  [/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We have increased the health of Rampart’s walls, particularly at earlier EVO levels.  [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Rampart is also getting a movement buff for her Ultimate: she now moves significantly faster while spinning up or shooting Sheila.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h1][b]LEGEND NERFS[/b][/h1][h2][b]VALKYRIE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Everyone’s favorite fighter pilot has remained in a strong position for a while now. As we work to manage power creep in our game, we felt Valk could use some slight nerfs to bring her in line.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5m4Z1u4LEctARtApdg3VGL/328e5a3bc048061ed931b09cee8f3af1/04_Plat__Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Valk_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked gameplay from 8-1-2025 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][p align="start"]Our first goal is to reduce her “artillery” potential - she can do significant poke damage from long range while having extra utility and mobility that others don’t.  [/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re reducing her missile damage, as well as adjusting the trajectory of her missiles so they can’t get over top of high cover as easily.  [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Additionally, we want to reduce her Ultimate’s ability to keep her and her squad far above the fight while also knowing exactly where everyone is. To accomplish this we’re lowering the height by 15% and nerfing two Upgrades. [/p][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Eye in the Sky:[/b] Reduced through-wall scans base distance to 100m[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supersonic:[/b] Slightly nerfed the speed improvement when blasting off from 2.5 seconds to 3.0 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]AXLE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Axle’s pick rate has been trending in a healthier direction with each subsequent nerf following her race to the top on release. Her Kickstart drone is still too oppressive in too many contexts, and we’re continuing to evaluate how to increase counterplay opportunities. Now that she’ll be affected by her own ult, Axle players should think twice before deploying it in close-quarters skirmishes. She can no longer stack two Ult charges, and we’ve reined in the overall range that players can super slide with her Nitro Gates. Quantitative data isn’t everything; we’re still keeping a close eye on player sentiment when it comes to Nitro Gate and Kickstart usage and will continue to adjust if needed.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7hpnBHwpDBVsUwnjNKgnLo/632e6db69b1305fd775e4178ab90f5a4/05_Share_of_Total_Selections_-_Axle_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.30859375,yPosition=0.47962962962962963" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked gameplay from 5-1-2026 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To restrict the range that players can slide, we’re reducing the max slide boost time from 5 seconds to 3 seconds.[/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To force players to be more selective when choosing to use Axle’s Ult, it will now affect self & allies (similar to Mad Maggie, Bangalore, and Gibraltar ultimates)[/p][list][*][p]Axle (self) gets damaged, stunned, and displaced (same as enemies)[/p][/*][*][p]Allies get stunned and displaced, but won’t take damage[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Replace Automata with [b]Long Haul[/b], which brings the Tac max slide time back up to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Shuffled order[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl 2: Sliding Shooter vs Long Haul[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl 3: Jump Gate vs Super Slider[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]SEER[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Seer’s back in the spotlight after our most recent round of buffs, and he’s been hard to ignore! Seer is a tricky Legend to balance, frequently yo-yo-ing between the absolute bottom and top of pick rate charts. He’s on a knife’s edge where a buff will either do very little, or make him entirely OP.[/p][p align="start"]The last time Seer hit the heights of the top 3 Legends in terms of pick rate, he dropped off on his own naturally after about a week. It seems our Artist-in-Residence has more staying power this time around, and not everyone is a fan.[/p][p align="start"]We already took a swipe at Seer’s Tactical uptime by reworking his Upgrade tree as part of a quick hotfix after the mid-season split. His new Level 3 Upgrade choices are much more evenly split than they were before in terms of pick-rate.[/p][p align="start"]However, it seems like Tactical uptime alone wasn’t the root of the problem, and we needed to roll back some of the new strength of the Tactical. Specifically, turn slow (slowing the rate at which you can rotate your Legend) was added to his ability at the mid-Season split, which was the straw that broke the camel’s back in terms of frustration. As a result, we will be making the turn slow much more subtle in Season 30.[/p][p align="start"]Our intent with Seer, and other ‘counter-movement’ Legends was to give tools to players that can counter the more mobile Legends of the roster. However, it seems like in practice all Legends were getting caught in Seer’s net. We will revisit how we implement these kinds of slows in the future to try and be more targeted towards just the speediest Legends of our cast.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h1][b]WEAPONS & LOOT[/b][/h1][h2][b]UI STAT OVERHAUL[/b][/h2][p align="start"]“What does a stock do?” This is the question the weapons team has been answering for the past 7 years. Sure, there is technically a block of text on each and every stock that reads out what it is actually doing to your weapon when you equip it, and let’s be honest, no one is reading that when a team has hot dropped next to you. It’s time to provide way more transparency around what each and every attachment actually does to your weapon when you go to equip it, and how the weapon itself measures up against every other weapon in the game, and we’re doing it in a few different ways.[/p][p align="start"]The lobby has received an update in the form of a new Playground tab under each weapon category. Players can quickly see at a glance a weapon’s stats, as well as how they change with a combination of all available attachment types.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6r2bFqMsOgJrBwYVEEe8CA/75a43023f0cb04bfd8f73b741ec79749/06..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.1484375,yPosition=0.4236111111111111" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In-game, players will see brand new weapon and attachment loot cards, as well as a new inventory hover state which shows a weapon’s stats and how each attachment affects them.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5k8erUMwGRC1CLIRT6A8dI/8d57f1ff3779f4b3ff7537d5d4ea33d5/07..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.634375,yPosition=0.4388888888888889" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2YpT1TWUyyw4tid9iMOhZ6/165f6d01a7f1a379c301b4b02af201de/08..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.614453125,yPosition=0.4895833333333333" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In implementing these changes, our main goals were to help with the onboarding of Apex’s weapon and attachment systems, to provide more clarity on how weapons work — their strengths and weaknesses — and how attachments affect their ability to perform in combat. Once a player has mastered the weapon and attachment system, they will always have the option to enable Compact UI mode and reduce the amount of information that is being displayed in-game.[/p][p align="start"]Now, feel empowered to enter into a game knowing full well what a stock does.[/p][h3][b]CORRUPTED ATTACHMENTS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]What better way to show off our new attachment UI than with some new attachments! Corrupted Attachments have entered the Apex Games.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2iFMUBt5kKplxiHrK7z08x/0a8147dd3b73343ceeb4748560d3bd2b/09..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6171875,yPosition=0.4847222222222222" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Corrupted Attachments are powerful items that can be equipped onto your weapons, providing them with some serious stat buffs, at the cost of reducing another. Kiss-Curse, if you will. Only one Corrupted Attachment can be equipped to a weapon at a time.[/p][p align="start"]Why Corrupted Attachments? We wanted to provide a new vector for choice and strategy when it came to picking and defining your weapon loadout. Since attachments were previously a linear upwards stat progression, the choice around your loadout often began and ended with the weapon itself. Now, you are poised with a strategic choice when you locate a Corrupted Attachment: Do I take this for a powerful upside at a cost? Or do I leave it for the next person to come along?[/p][h3][b]REVAMPED POWER JOURNEY[/b][/h3][p align="start"]“Cool, Corrupted Attachments, where can I find them in the loot pool?” Short answer: high-tier loot locations. Long answer… Well, let’s talk about what a high-tier loot location really is.[/p][p align="start"]Like we talked about before, Apex Legends is in its 7th year, and we have made many changes to our loot over that time. Loot has been our main carrot at the end of the stick for many of our systems, and thus loot creep has become a real issue. Your looting experience, your power journey, has become quite flat, often with large early game spikes of high tier loot into a pretty substantial flatline.[/p][p align="start"]We want your power journey to feel more consistent over the course of a match, and for those moments when you find a purple mag off drop to feel powerful once again. To accomplish this, we are taking a huge swing at re-balancing our loot pools and loot delivery systems. Next season you will see an overall reduction in the quality of loot that is spawned. The quantity of loot is unchanged. What this means is that where once you could find a plethora of purple and gold tiered items in a normal POI, those have been replaced with white and blues, with the occasional chance at those top-tier purple items. Similarly, a lot of our readily accessible loot delivery systems like loot rollers and Arsenals are seeing a similar change.[/p][p align="start"]“So where are those Corrupted Attachments you were talking about?” Similar to purple items, you will rarely find them in the standard loot pool, with a significantly higher chance of them spawning in our rarer or single use loot delivery systems. For example, hitting up Trials on World’s Edge will yield a much higher chance at getting those purple loot items or Corrupted Attachments. The idea is that while the quality of loot has been reduced across the map, those special loot locations like vaults, Icarus’s Bridge, and certainly care packages, will be your new vector for your best chances at those high tier loot rolls.[/p][p align="start"]There are a ton of updates coming that are under the umbrella of this change, all of which will be covered in detail in the patch notes, but here are a few of the major ones to be on the lookout for:[/p][list][*][p][b]ALL MAP LOOT TABLES:[/b] Reworked[/p][/*][*][p][b]ARSENALS:[/b] Reworked[/p][/*][*][p][b]EXTENDED SUPPLY BINS & WEAPON SUPPLY BINS:[/b] Removed[/p][/*][*][p][b]LOOT BIN RESET:[/b] Reworked[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]ENERGY AMMO REWORK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Last but not least, we have upcoming changes to how Energy Weapons work![/p][p align="start"]Energy Weapons now come with a regenerating stockpile of ammo. Once players use this ammo, over time, and while the weapon is idle, the ammo will begin to regenerate its supply in the weapon, allowing you to continue the fight without needing to manually loot to replenish.[/p][p align="start"]The goal of this change was to provide another way to think about your weapon loadout choice, and why you are picking one weapon over another. Are you grabbing a Volt because you dropped hot and don’t have time to worry about looting ammo? Or is it because you need those inventory slots to carry extra meds for your teammates? [/p][p align="start"]This rework is not exclusive to the BR; all Energy Weapons across the BR, Mixtape and Wildcard will see this change in effect.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We hope this blog has been helpful in deepening your understanding of the dev team’s decision making processes behind implementing new systems and making balancing changes. For a thorough change log of everything coming in Marked, be sure to check out the full Patch Notes, dropping on August 3rd, 2026![/p][p align="start"][url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/buy"]Play Apex Legends for free[/url]* now on PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox® One, Xbox® Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and PC via the EA app, Epic, and Steam.[/p][p align="start"]Follow Apex Legends™ on [url="https://twitter.com/PlayApex"]Twitter/X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/playapex/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@PlayApex"]TikTok[/url], subscribe to our [url="https://www.youtube.com/playapex%20"]YouTube channel[/url], and check out our [url="https://answers.ea.com/t5/Apex-Legends/ct-p/apex-legends-en"]forums[/url].[/p][p align="start"]Sign up for our [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/newsletter"]newsletter[/url] today to receive the latest Apex Legends news, updates, behind-the-scenes content, exclusive offers, and more (including other EA news, products, events, and promotions) by email.[/p][p align="start"]This announcement may change as we listen to community feedback and continue developing and evolving our Live Service & Content. We will always strive to keep our community as informed as possible. For more information, please refer to EA’s Online Service Updates at [/p][p][url="https://www.ea.com/service-updates"]https://www.ea.com/service-updates[/url][/p][p align="start"].[/p][p align="start"]*Applicable platform account and platform subscription (sold separately) may be required. newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti-Cheat Team - 07/13/2026
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[p]Cheating has consequences beyond a single account. [/p][p]Since the end of April, we have executed nearly [b]6,000 hardware bans[/b] across PC and console. While the majority of those bans impacted players on PC, we are actively increasing our utilization of hardware bans on consoles. [/p][p]Hardware bans are one of many tools in our Anti-Cheat Team’s toolbelt and allow us to target systems designed to evade enforcement. Our tools identify repeat offenders and ensure that they will be unable to access Apex Legends,  even if they spin up new accounts.[/p][p]We occasionally see the community requesting hardware bans as a more permanent punishment for cheaters, and we wanted to provide more transparency into the matter - hardware bans [i]are [/i]happening (and they’re represented [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/apexlegends/comments/1tjqraf/an_update_from_the_anti_cheat_team_05212026/"]in our ban number comms[/url]) and we are planning to utilize them even more, especially on consoles.[/p][p]So, “why isn’t every ban worthy of a hardware ban?” Hardware bans are our most severe penalty so we reserve it as a proportional response when we encounter high severity cheating. We strive to reform rather than permanently banishing players from our game, so hardware bans typically target malicious bad actors and serial cheaters.[/p][p]We are continuing to invest in new detections, strengthen our enforcement, and take action against those who threaten the integrity of Apex Legends. Fair play remains our priority.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - Auto Aim Manipulation
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[p]Effective immediately, the use of “jitter aim” and/or RC filters to exploit aim assist systems and negate recoil on controllers [b]is unequivocally considered cheating[/b]. We are taking a firm stance against players using these cheats and are taking action to stop them.[/p][p][/p][p]Apex Legends is now equipped with the necessary in-game detections to identify and disable these exploits. Players who are caught attempting to use hardware or software to alter aim assist or recoil patterns will be flagged as cheaters and have their accounts banned in accordance with our TOS.[/p][p][/p][p]We are implementing this crackdown at a crucial time, to support fair play at EWC Paris, in addition to maintaining competitive integrity across Apex Legends. While we are implementing this solution to combat the issue, we have alternate anti-cheat approaches we can pivot to should we need them. We will continue to monitor the situation and make additional changes as necessary.[/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends™: Overclocked Midseason Patch Notes
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]INTRO[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome back to Overclocked Split 2! To start the latter half of the season, we’re bringing Legend balancing changes, new shotgun hop-ups, and various fixes and improvements that we think you’re going to like a lot. With all these changes landing on June 23rd, it’s the perfect time to grab your squad and dive into Overclocked![/p][h2][b]ANTI-CHEAT UPDATE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We cannot overstate the value we put on competitive integrity in Apex Legends; hopefully you’ve seen our [u][url="https://x.com/ApexLiveComms/status/2057507108678181027"]incremental and seasonal recap account ban updates[/url][/u]. We have also been working hard behind the scenes to eradicate less conventional hacks. This season, we implemented detection for a reverse speed hack, preventing cheaters from freezing themselves mid-air for long stretches of time. Additionally, we identified and resolved numerous exploits that could be used to take down servers. Combatting cheaters is a constant cat and mouse game, as such, we are not always able to discuss [i]all[/i] the things we’re working on, lest we tip our hand to bad actors. Rest assured, we are committed to making Apex Legends the cleanest it can possibly be, and we are working on things that we’re excited to be able to share with you soon. Please continue to report suspected cheaters, your reports help inform our anti-cheat work![/p][h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1][h2][b]LEGENDS[/b][/h2][p][b]BALLISTIC[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Ballistic has been strong in the past but after a bunch of nerfs he’s fallen close to the bottom in pickrate. We wanted to bring some of his power back but we understand he was pretty frustrating to fight against in his prime. This goal with his Tactical buff is to bring back some of the previous numbers but we wanted to add more counterplay options for the victims. The speed boost on the Ultimate was also very powerful but it could make Ballistic’s team very difficult to fight. Instead, we’re only giving a sprint boost which should still allow for fast pushes as a team but not a speed advantage during the fight.[/i][/p][p][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ballistic now respawns with his Sling weapon in all game modes.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Overheat now only applies to one weapon.[/p][list][*][p]If a player has a weapon out when hit by Whistler the overheat debuff applies only to that weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]If the player is unarmed when hit by Whistler it applies to the weapon in the first weapon slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Overheat no longer degrades when not firing or swapping to another weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Overheat does not increment when swapping to another weapon and shooting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overheat damage increased from 15 to 50.[/p][/*][*][p]Overheat debuff duration increased from 12 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased time between firing and when homing activates.[/p][/*][*][p]The overheat debuff no longer re-applies if you hit someone who is already overheating and you cannot apply it to multiple guns on the same player.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ballistic and teammates within range get a sprint boost when his Ultimate is activated. (Previously only Ballistic got a speed boost)[/p][list][*][p]Sprint boost will only apply a speed boost while sprinting and will not speed up other types of movement.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level 2[/p][list][*][p][b]Extra Bullet:[/b] Gain an additional Tactical charge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trap Mode:[/b] When placed in the world, Ballistic’s KTactical lasts 15 seconds and deals 35 damage if an enemy walks into it.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Level 3[/p][list][*][p][b]Quiet Time:[/b] Ballistic’s Tactical no longer applies overheat. Instead it adds silence and slow on [i]hit[/i]. It also has a longer cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Killing Time:[/b] Now moved to level 3, still provides a 15 second extension to Ballistic’s Ultimate.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]PATHFINDER[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Your favourite friendly robot has been a bit outclassed by other skirmishers. We wanted to touch the uptime on his abilities to help him keep pace and improve his Upgrades to be more in line with other Legends that get perks from other classes.[/i][/p][p][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pathfinder now tucks in his legs while riding horizontal ziplines.[/p][list][*][p]This should make him a little harder to hit when riding on his Ultimate and other ziplines in the world. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tactical charges increased from 1 to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the progressive cooldown and it is now a flat 20 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased launch speed of the zipline projectile.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced cooldown from 3 minutes to 2 minutes.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Upgrades[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level 2[/p][list][*][p][b]Field Research:[/b] Now grants all Recon perks instead of just the survey beacon scan.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ringmaster:[/b] Now grants all Controller perks instead of just the ring console access.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Level 3[/p][list][*][p][b]Landing Gear:[/b] Grants more air control and faster recovery from hard landings. This replaces the 2 Tactical charges Upgrade. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]SEER[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Seer saw a bit of an uptick after his last set of buffs but has settled back down toward the bottom. He is, however, seeing some play in higher Ranked lobbies so we know he has potential. For this update we focused on quality of life buffs. We’ve done a pass on making his Passive and Tactical more responsive.[/i][/p][p][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the activation speed of the heartbeat sensor.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the interval time between heartbeats.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased activation time for unarmed ADSing [/p][/*][*][p]Made the delay when aiming more consistent between weapon and unarmed. [/p][list][*][p]This means the heartbeat sensor will appear at the same time regardless of the weapon you’re using.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the delay between the launch and hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the slow on hit, should now halt faster moving Legends more effectively.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upon deployment, there is now a quick 2 second scan of the area which will highlight any enemy in the area.[/p][list][*][p]Enemies that enter the area after it’s deployed will also be scanned for 2 seconds. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cloaked enemies will now show footsteps if they are within the Ultimate zone. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]AXLE[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Axle has undeniably pushed the pace of play. With these nerfs, we want to target areas that cause the most frustration while staying true to her identity as an aggressive lateral speedster with team utility. Considering the popularity of her “Super Slider” upgrade, her Tactical has simply been available too frequently, nullifying much of the risk that should be considered when overextending. We also saw an opportunity to add some agency to Kickstart victims, when evading or destroying the drone simply isn’t an option.[/i][/p][p align="start"]From 5/29 Hotfix:[/p][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced max in-world count from 3 to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced hp from 150 to 100.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]29.1:[/p][p][b]Passive/Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Knocked players can no longer slide across zip codes as Axle or while under the effect of a Nitro Gate. She is doing a lot and her Tactical is completely controlling the battlefield. Her Ultimate creates an issue similar to previous-era-Ballistic, where the added speed boost is making players very difficult to lock down. In this case, we’re introducing a series of nerfs to bring her pick rate down to a more healthy space.[/i][/p][p][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Cooldown from 22 seconds to 28 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]The speed boost granted from running on the pucks dropped by the wrecking ball has been replaced by a sprint boost. [/p][list][*][p]Will no longer speed up all movement, just when sprinting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]VALKYRIE[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Valkyrie is becoming one of the top picked Legends and has been performing really well over the last few seasons. We understand this doesn’t address other aspects of her kit that are strong, but we are continuing to monitor her match data and will make additional changes if necessary.[/i][/p][p][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the recent improvement, which allowed her to land faster from skydiving. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]CONDUIT[/b][/p][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Since her changes at the beginning of Season 29, Conduit spiked to the top of the pick rates and remained at that spot several weeks later. newsitems.title: Overclocked Midseason Designer’s Notes
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]TL;DR[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Below, we will share insights into meta changes coming in 29.1. We’ll discuss the rationale for the implementations, including the opportunities we’ve identified, and our goals for each of the following:[/p][list][*][p]“Why wait to tweak Axle?”[/p][/*][*][p]Axle Nerf Details[/p][/*][*][p]Ballistic Refresh[/p][/*][*][p]Pathfinder Buff[/p][/*][*][p]Seer Buff[/p][/*][*][p]Mad Maggie Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Valkyrie Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Conduit Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]A New Shotgun Hop-Up, and A Hop Up Shuffle[/p][/*][*][p]Regional Differences in Play[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]INTRODUCTION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome to Designer’s Notes for Split 2 of Overclocked. We appreciate all the time you spent playing last split, and the feedback you have been giving all season long. With your feedback and our internal match data, we have been tuning and adjusting to get ready for our next update.[/p][p align="start"]This split, we are excited to bring impactful updates to Ballistic, Pathfinder, and Seer that create new ways to play. We also have plans to shake-up the hop-ups rotation and reinvigorate the weapon meta.[/p][p align="start"]Our aim with this blog is to provide ongoing transparency and reasoning for [i]why[/i] we are making balancing choices and feature additions in each update. We want you to head into your matches with this knowledge, discuss how the changes are landing, and let us know what’s working and what isn’t. Your continued feedback is important in helping us tune Apex and make it the best competitive Battle Royale it can be![/p][h2][b]“WHY WAIT TO TWEAK AXLE?”[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We had a great start to Season 29 and it was awesome seeing all the different ways Axle impacted the meta. That said, we know Axle has the perception of being a bit too disruptive and we wanted to have an open discussion about it.[/p][p align="start"]Ultimately, we aim to tune our new Legends [i]strong[/i]; it is an intentional choice. When we release a new Legend, the goal is to drive meaningful impact on the game and encourage players to evolve their strategies and tactics to remain competitive. In the past, we have found that if we ship a Legend - or any feature, for that matter - in a weak state, it has little to no impact; players are simply not incentivized to try something new if it does not shift the meta in a meaningful way and create new ways of play. We know this can be controversial, but we have found it better to tune down a spicy Legend and allow them to settle into their place in the meta, rather than try to tune up a low-impact Legend to make them a more appealing pick. First impressions matter, and if the first impression is lacking, it’s difficult to change minds.[/p][p align="start"]We have seen the question many times: [b]why wait to adjust Axle?[/b] We saw frustration with Axle at launch, but we also saw a lot of positive reception. With any major additions, it’s important to allow time for the meta to settle and make well-informed decisions backed by match data. As such, we need to gather several weeks of data. There was also the added wrinkle that Axle didn’t require Legend Tokens to unlock for the first two weeks; this obviously meant that she would have a larger representation in match data, so we needed to clear the temporary unlock period to get definitive data on her usage. After that period, we made some quick decisions to rein in her power a bit by releasing small, mid-split nerfs to her Tactical. With this mid-season update we are going to take another pass with more impactful changes, as we still feel she is not where she needs to be, from a balance perspective, and to assuage some of the frustration.[/p][p align="start"]In the end, we appreciate you working with us to help tune the meta. The match data you contribute by playing and the feedback you give is instrumental in our decision making.[/p][h1][b]LEGENDS[/b][/h1][h2][b]AXLE NERF[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With all that context in mind, what [i]are[/i] we doing with Axle? We have been incredibly happy with how much fun players have been having with Axle on launch. We saw her played a ton through her 2-week temporary unlock period, and she’s remained popular beyond that as a great addition to many different squads. But we need to address community concerns and an incredibly high pick rate.[/p][p align="start"]With so many Axles zipping around, we’ve identified a couple of key themes within community frustrations. One, her ability to generate so many Nitro Gates in quick succession makes her mobility [i]too[/i] free and can clutter up the battlefield. Two, her Kickstart Ultimate launches its victims in a very predictable trajectory, which is often a death sentence against skilled shooters.[/p][p align="start"]We aren’t [i]racing[/i] to nerf Axle into the ground, but these two frustrations are consistent enough that we need to address them directly, and are therefore making changes to Axle in the mid-season split. First, we are replacing her Level 2 upgrade, Super Slider, with a new Upgrade that reduces her Tactical’s cooldown and increases the number of Nitro Gates you can have active back up to the amount she had on release (3 instead of 2). You can see in the following chart that Super Slider was far and away the favourite throughout the release split, even when the competing level 2 Upgrade is also very strong - a key indicator of unhealthy balance.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4gtl6CuD0y3rqtrNL7ReOq/41e21ab50246d6e3ef8f9257c7ab0fa1/01_Legend_Upgrade_Selections_-_Axle.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2026-05-27 through 2026-06-02[/i][/p][p align="start"]To address the frustrations with Kickstart, especially in anticipation of more players picking the Upgrade that grants you two charges, we are changing how its ‘boop’ works. Starting in 29.1, when hit by a Kickstart, you will no longer be thrown straight up to freefall back down. Instead, you will be launched in an arc that inherits some of your velocity at the moment you are hit. This gives the Kickstart victim more agency in how they’re moved by the Ultimate, because they now have influence over where they are tossed.[/p][p align="start"]We are approaching tuning Axle from the Upgrade side to keep her core kit fun to use, while at the same time reducing her access to resources when fully upgraded.[/p][h2][b]BALLISTIC REFRESH[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In the past, Ballistic had a moment in the sun where he was quite strong but was often frustrating to fight against, a combo that resulted in a set of nerfs. While the nerfs lessened frustrations, they also dramatically lowered his pick rate. With this update we are looking to bring back some of his power while providing important, new counterplay options for players hit by his Overheat. We also want to bring back some of the team utility his Ultimate offered, but in a healthier state. With all of these changes, we’re hoping to scoop his pick rate up off the floor.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1S6gHlfxXek5OB9mut9jnM/6d1cb2f4ab4d6fa2bafa3b676c3cbfa5/02_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Ballistic.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2025-01-01 through 2026-05-28[/i][/p][h3][b]Passive[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’ve tweaked the Sling weapon so it respawns when Ballistic does, in every game mode. [/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The overheat mechanic tied to Ballistic’s Tactical has created a frustrating play pattern. When your gun overheats, your only options become: run away and wait, or just eat the damage. So we’re changing overheat so that it only applies to your currently active weapon or, if you’re unarmed, it will apply to the weapon in your first inventory slot. This will allow you to swap off the weapon that is overheating and use your second weapon freely. By establishing this counter play, it allows us to bring back the power that overheat previously had. [/p][p align="start"]Ballistic will start with two Tactical charges, overheat damage is back to 50, and there has been some improvements to the delay between firing and activating projectile homing. The overheat will not degrade if you stop shooting or swap weapons but the debuff can no longer be re-applied. We’ve also increased the time from 12 seconds to 15. [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Looking at Ballistic's Ultimate, pre-nerf, the speed given to the team was very strong and made fighting a team buffed by Ballistic very difficult. We wanted to bring some of the speed back to help enable pushing as a team but not make players speedy during the fight. To accomplish this we’ve opted for a sprint boost instead of an overall speed boost.[/p][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Extra Bullet:[/b] Grants Ballistic one more Tactical charge, allowing for three total. [/p][p align="start"][b]Trap Mode:[/b] Grants a modified version of Lasting Bullet. This will still have the longer duration of the in-world Whistler and now also deals 35 damage when in its trap state. [/p][p align="start"][b]Quiet Time:[/b] Has been modified to apply silence on hit instead of on overheat. With this upgrade it will no longer apply the overheat debuff. The silence effect will also have a short slow on impact.[/p][p align="start"][b]Killing Time:[/b] Remains the same but has been moved to level three.[/p][h2][b]PATHFINDER BUFF[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Pathfinder has been a bit outclassed by other Skirmishers and is the lowest it’s been since the beginning of the year.. He’s still very fun to play and can be powerful, but we found that the uptime for his abilities is longer than for other Legends. Changing his hitbox isn’t something we want to explore but we have given him a little something to make him safer on horizontal ziplines.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5GdxYKoemchbj00wq76R0d/d29442175015a2d43cc315651e7e731c/03_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Skirmishers.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2025-02-03 through 2026-05-28[/i][/p][p align="start"]Pathfinder's new Passive sees him lift his legs up when riding horizontal ziplines. Just kidding, this isn’t a new Passive but it is a small improvement we wanted to add to make him feel safer on ziplines. He does have a large hitbox so this should help him utilize his Ultimate more effectively.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/mC09r0TXl2kijncpuXegD/8183d5fa1d6c709fd074ad1a106820a2/pathy_knees_up.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re giving Pathfinder’s Tactical two charges and a flat cooldown of 20 seconds. This should help establish more reliable grapple availability. [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re speeding up the delivery speed of the zipline. This should speed up the process of setting up and hopping onto the zipline. We’re also reducing the cooldown, which should make you feel more comfortable using your Ultimate more often.[/p][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Field Research:[/b] Will grant all the Recon class perks instead of just access to the survey beacons. This will now give him the added bonus of seeing threats while ADS.[/p][p align="start"][b]Ringmaster:[/b] Will grant all the Controller class perks instead of just access to the ring console. This will provide the added bonus of overshield while in the ring and the Evac Tower that spawns upon use of the ring console. He will also be able to reinforce Hardlight. [/p][p align="start"][b]New Upgrade:[/b] We are replacing Grapple God with [b]Landing Gear.[/b] This will give Pathfinder better air control and the Soft Landings Passive, allowing for quick recoveries when landing from high heights. [/p][h2][b]SEER BUFF[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Seer’s pick rate is still fairly low but he is seeing success when played in higher Ranked lobbies. For his balancing pass, we mainly wanted to provide some quality of life updates by speeding up some of his abilities and adding some initial information when he deploys his Ultimate. We also wanted to give him the ability to slow down enemies hit by his Tactical as a way to impede all those zippy Octanes and Axles.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/47guTbqlRgJPFvDwyioIDq/62375b1038867fd7dc5f3dd327f77afa/04_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Seer.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2025-02-03 through 2026-05-28[/i][/p][h3][b]Passive[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re speeding up the activation time on the heartbeat sensor, increasing heartbeat intervals and increasing unarmed ADS speed. This means you’ll experience a shorter delay before the monitor starts pulsing, more frequent heartbeats, and more consistency whether unarmed or weapon equipped. We’re also making changes to establish more consistency in the timing before the heartbeat sensor appears between weapon-equipped and unarmed. [/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re reducing the delay between launch and hit of the Tactical, which should make it easier to land hits . We’re also strengthening the slow on hit to be more impactful on players' momentum while using high speed abilities, like Axle’s slide and Ash’s dash for example.[/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]For Seer’s Ultimate, we’re adding a short scan that will occur when the zone is created. This will help inform you who’s in the zone before you need to start looking for footsteps. This quick scan will also show any new enemies that enter the zone after it’s been activated. Additionally, cloaked enemies in the zone will now leave tracked footsteps.[/p][h2][b]MAD MAGGIE NERF[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Maggie has been a top performer for a while and, with the rise of Gibby, she’s seeing even more play. She is doing a lot and her Tactical is completely controlling the battlefield. Her Ultimate creates an issue similar to previous-era-Ballistic, where the added speed boost is making players very difficult to lock down. In this case, we’re introducing a series of nerfs to bring her pick rate down to a healthier space.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/55Hi5f2sgV3PAZfg74dle6/59371466e934031c31c7a90514b687b9/05_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Mad_Maggie___Gibraltar.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6828125,yPosition=0.45925925925925926" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2025-02-03 through 2026-05-28[/i][/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re increasing the cooldown of Maggie’s Tactical to help mitigate how many are being placed in the world. Hopefully this will make players a little more deliberate when choosing the right circumstances to use their Tactical. [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]For the Ultimate, we’re swapping the speed boost from the pucks for a sprint boost. Similar to the changes to Ballistic, we still want players to have the pushing potential and the ability to get to enemies fast, but we don’t want to boost the overall speed, making them difficult to pin down in combat. [/p][h2][b]VALKYRIE NERF[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Valkyrie is becoming one of the top picked Legends and has been performing really well over the last few seasons. We are making a minor adjustment to help assuage frustrations and manage her climbing pick rate. We understand this doesn’t address other aspects of her kit that are strong, but we are continuing to monitor her match data and will make additional changes if necessary.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/4fHXYsWYCUIXcMtP49bdVA/59931fd241660388bc3e41890440ec0a/06_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Valkyrie.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.28854166666666664,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2025-11-01 through 2026-05-31[/i][/p][p align="start"]When Valkyrie received her last round of buffs she got improvements to her landing from Skydive, allowing her to land much faster than other Legends. Players have been leveraging this quick recovery by scanning from the air and quickly dropping on teams, giving them little time to react. Therefore, we are removing the landing improvements to help establish consistency across all Legends. [/p][h2][b]CONDUIT NERF[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Since her changes at the beginning of Season 29, Conduit spiked to the top of the pick rates and remained at that spot several weeks later. We’re so excited to see that players have really felt the improvements to Conduit’s supportive agency and playmaking potential. However, we recognize that she has been a key enabler of Legends that push the meta in an extremely aggressive way. Additionally, her dominance crowds out all other Support Legends, making her an obvious pick. Finally, she was present in 8 of the top 10 most popular team compositions. All of these indicators point to an unhealthy balance state and, as a result, we want to take steps to slow things down a bit.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7tqVGqAQ28ZgksFsW6iO94/37481f5727c49b8f3226ffe8b225a7f5/07_Daily_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Conduit.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.34869791666666666,yPosition=0.47453703703703703" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2026-05-03 through 2026-05-31[/i][/p][p align="start"]We are splitting Conduit’s nerfs into several small, calculated adjustments to keep an eye on how her performance and popularity shifts. Our goal is to ensure there are plenty of viable, powerful Legends to choose from without immediately grounding Conduit right after picking her up.[/p][h3][b]Recent Changes[/b][/h3][p align="start"]In an earlier hotfix, we shifted Conduit’s Tactical regeneration to take longer to provide a similar amount of shielding. This also inherently affects the imbalanced pick rate of her new level 3 Upgrades, making the burst of shielding Instant Barrier provides more attractive in comparison to the slow ‘n’ steady Enduring Barrier.[/p][h3][b]New Changes[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Now, we’re increasing the cooldown on Conduit’s Tactical. The double Tactical charge has been a huge win in making Conduit feel flexible in keeping her squad topped off, but we want to reduce how frequently it's used to demand skillful and measured usage of her supportive tools. Additionally, Enduring Barrier no longer regenerates through ring damage, slightly restricting the wide range of its use cases.[/p][h1][b]WEAPONS[/b][/h1][h2][b]A NEW SHOTGUN HOP-UP, AND A HOP UP SHUFFLE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We’ve talked about it before in Patch Notes and Designer’s Notes, and we will say it again: shotguns are some of our more tempestuous weapons in the roster. They ride a fine line between feeling undertuned and undersatisfying vs. overpowered and frustrating to play against, and their current position in the meta leans toward the former.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2HNuzAIAkBQNrYZD1nBHd1/69f85960b9d8979ac5937e4a9fb55609/08_Weapon_Share_of_Downs_and_Encounter_Win_Rate_-_Shotguns.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.24869791666666666,yPosition=0.47453703703703703" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2026-05-26 through 2026-06-01[/i][/p][p align="start"]Particularly, we are seeing the sting the most in our finisher style shotguns: the Mastiff and the Peacekeeper. Looking deeper into the data, we see that on average shotguns are the weapons players die while holding most. Our hypothesis is: these weapons [i]are[/i] securing knocks, but the close-range encounters where shotguns thrive lead to extremely low health, and result in a quick follow-up avenging from enemy teammates. How often have you gotten that quick swap to the Peacekeeper, secure the down, only to be killed a moment or two later?[/p][p align="start"]Instead of doing raw damage buffs to this class of finisher shotguns, we have opted to give them a new survivability style hop-up, aptly called [b]Executioner[/b]. Once the hop-up has been unlocked, securing a knock will begin a shield regeneration over a few seconds, similar to that of the Skirmisher Knock Expert perk, and yes, they will stack. Our goal is to provide shotguns with more utility and less raw fire power. The close range fights should feel the same, but this gives these weapons a little more juice to stay in the fire fight afterwards. Executioner will be available on the Peacekeeper and the Mastiff, replacing Disruptor Rounds and Dual Shell.[/p][p align="start"]Mozambique and EVA-8 will also get a little bump to their base handling stats so they don’t feel left out of the party.[/p][p align="start"]In addition to the introduction of the Executioner Hop-up, we’ll also be passing the Graffiti Mod to the Volt and Flatline to inject some freshness to the weapon meta.[/p][h2][b]REGIONAL DIFFERENCES IN PLAY[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In general, we have been pretty happy with how the weapon meta has been shaking out over the past few months. While we can acknowledge a few outliers, the majority of our roster has been sitting in an overall healthy spot. We wanted to take this time to quickly point out some weapon balance outliers and explain why you may not see as much shake-up on some of our more popular, high performing weapons, where you might expect them. Let’s look at the Alternator as an example.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5kvyiZ3RAVQ0ocnMgyWX12/a693ee135416da4a43f2571b09f3f84b/09_Weapon_Share_of_Downs_and_Encounter_Win_Rate_-_Alternator.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6057291666666667,yPosition=0.47453703703703703" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay. 2026-05-26 through 2026-06-01[/i][/p][p align="start"]The Alternator has been making some steady upwards momentum since the addition of the Double Tap Hop-Up a few seasons ago, and even after some adjustments, continues to climb. Anecdotally, we weren’t hearing too much conversation about it over here in the western hemisphere, as most of the balance concerns from our community centered around the R-99, so we dug deeper.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2qwKK8aExPqEy0DSqiiI36/662dc1488956eefbf18a20ebc3dada29/10_Regional_Share_of_Downs_-_Alternator.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.28854166666666664,yPosition=0.5305555555555556" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Turns out, Alternator popularity in our metrics is being pretty heavily driven by our players over in Japan! It’s a super interesting statistic, and illustrates some of the less obvious factors contributing to weapon usage and efficiency data. Regional differences like this are something that our weapon meta team will be continuing to evaluate and reacting to moving forward.[/p][p align="start"]As always, we will be keeping a close eye on how the weapon meta shakes out this season and will update you with any meta hotfixes throughout the season.[/p][h2][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We hope this blog has been helpful in deepening your understanding of the processes and rationale informing the development team’s balancing changes. For a comprehensive log of all changes coming in Overclocked Split 2 be sure to check out the full Patch Notes dropping on June 22nd, 2026![/p]

newsitems.title: An Update from the Anti Cheat Team - 06/17/2026
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[p]Over the past several months, the Anti-Cheat Team team has been developing, testing, and validating a *new* detection system which resulted in identifying and removing [b]1,000 accounts[/b] for using unauthorized software/gameplay enhancements, in its first week alone! These bans also targeted Xim and Titan users, expanding our protection against those cheating devices. [/p][p]This detection tool was deployed to the live game after extensive verification to ensure a high degree of accuracy. The 1,000 account marker was hit while being quite conservative with enforcement so we expect this number to grow significantly in the coming weeks as we expand its reach and tune it accordingly.

Additionally, we executed a highly focused and targeted ban wave of the top 100 positions on leaderboards for each platform. As a result, you may notice some high profile names missing from the leaderboards. The wave resulted in the following bans:[/p][list][*][p]Console - 79[/p][/*][*][p]PC - 7[/p][/*][/list][p]This style of targeted integrity check is executed on a regular cadence as one of the many tools in our anti-cheat toolbelt.[/p][p]We are still hard at work on more controller cheating detections that we mentioned in previous posts. The system we are building is extensive, requires a substantial number of moving parts, and analysis of large amounts of match data. While it may feel like a slow process to some, we need to be as thorough as possible to provide reliable, accurate detections to reduce the risk of false positives while taking swift action against players who use these devices to cheat.

This is not a one-time effort. We will continue monitoring, refining, and expanding our anti-cheat capabilities to stay ahead of emerging threats and help ensure a fair experience for all players.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who continues to report suspicious behavior in pursuit of a healthier Apex Legends experience.[/p][p]We'll have more to share as we continue this work in the coming weeks. [/p][p]
[/p]

newsitems.title: Apex Legends: Matchmaking Tests Update
newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents:
[p]For a fully translated version of the update, see [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/news/overclocked-matchmaking-update"]here[/url].[/p][h2][/h2][p]As part of our ongoing commitment to transparency, we’ve been more direct in sharing our approach to developing Apex Legends, a critical part of this approach is listening to you all in the community, understanding their needs, and working to address them. As such, we wanted to highlight the work being done on matchmaking to provide an even better experience for our players.[/p][p][/p][p]Below, we’ll be discussing the frustrations we’re consistently working to alleviate, the various changes we’ve made and tests we’ve run, what outcomes we’re targeting, as well as what we’ve learned and how we’re using it to improve matchmaking moving forward. [/p][p][/p][p]Read on to learn all about:[/p][list][*][p]Five major matchmaking pain points[/p][/*][*][p]Parameters and results of recent matchmaking tests:[/p][list][*][p]Increased maximum queue search times[/p][/*][*][p]Bots in mid-tier unranked lobbies[/p][/*][*][p]Diamond+ solo-queue only[/p][/*][*][p]4.5 Hour Ranked map rotations[/p][/*][*][p]1-tier locked Ranked premades[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The challenges of testing[/p][/*][/list][h2]DEFINING MATCHMAKING PAIN POINTS[/h2][p]You have made it clear, and we understand: Long queues and endlessly sweaty matches are the opposite of fun.[/p][p][/p][p]We are always listening and talking with players, we hear the feedback and frustration. It’s important that we balance your feedback and match data, so while we’re seeing that the majority of matches are fast and fair, we also see a smaller outlier of unacceptable matches that we’re committed to addressing to improve the overall game experience. Over the past few seasons, we've been focused on what our players are saying and exploring match data to identify a list of five main pain points which we use to guide our work on Matchmaking systems.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what we've been hearing:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Queue Times[/b]: No one wants to wait forever to get into a match. There is an inherent trade-off between faster queue times and a fairer match, but we also know that no one should have to spend more time in queue than actually playing. We see this frustration amplified in Ranked as it's the mode in which players will wait longer for matches with tighter matchmaking.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Lobby Skill Disparity[/b]: The skill gaps in your matches can be too wide. Veterans and casuals shouldn't be competing in the same lobby. Both Ranked and Unranked matches see the problem of Lobby Skill Disparity, and we approach both modes with different proposed solutions based on differing player needs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Solos vs Premade Imbalance:[/b] Solo players are at a disadvantage against coordinated three-stacks, especially in Ranked. Communication and coordination are part of the core game loop and bring real advantages, but they shouldn't be that decisive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Teammate Quality:[/b] You're paired with teammates who don't match your playstyle or skill level.  Inconsistent experiences impact match quality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sweaty Lobbies: [/b]No one has fun when [i]every single[/i] match feels like it’s your pain and someone else's gain. There is a time and a place for hyper-competitive matches, and you should know when you’re opting into the experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Every bullet here touches the core functions of the matchmaker. Pull one lever and everything else shifts along. It’s a tough balancing act. That's why over the past year, we've been methodical about testing solutions and tracking how each adjustment ripples through matchmaking.[/p][h1]RECENT TESTS[/h1][p]Matchmaking tests and experiments are run on specific regional servers to ensure that we can get clear data when we compare against other regions playing during the same period.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past year, we have increased the number of tests, and are planning to continue with a regular cadence moving forward. Here's what we've learned.[/p][h2]TEST: INCREASED MAXIMUM QUEUE SEARCH TIMES[/h2][p][b]Which pain point are we addressing? [/b]Queue Times, Lobby Skill Disparity, Teammate Quality[/p][p][/p][p][b]What was the test?[/b] The matchmaker searches, initially, for an opponent of closely-aligned skill level, and incrementally expands the search, loosening the skill restriction over time. For this test, we increased the search window from 30 seconds to 60 seconds before expanding the matchmaking criteria. This gives the matchmaker more time to find fairly-matched players instead of immediately widening the skill range in favour of more quickly filling a lobby.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What were the results?[/b] We saw a positive impact on match quality and much fewer skill mismatches, especially at the high end of competition (visualized below), in both Ranked and Unranked without significantly increasing queue times.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/9dda8e1c01e5ee06b49b311635616146f614653e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]What are the next steps?[/b] Given the positive results, we implemented this globally on May 7th, 2026 as part of our standard matchmaking logic in Ranked and Unranked Trios. But we are not stopping there. We are continuing to tweak and monitor edge-cases to ensure that no one waits more than the intended maximum queue wait time before getting into a match.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]TEST: BOTS IN LOWER-SKILL UNRANKED LOBBIES[/h2][p][b]Which pain point are we addressing? [/b]Queue Times, Lobby Skill Disparity, Teammate Quality[/p][p][/p][p][b]What did we test?[/b] [/p][p]We enabled bot-fill in mid-tier lobbies of Duos and Pub Trios matches, to understand whether they improved matchmaking quality and overall player experience. As a reminder: there are no plans to add bots to Ranked, and bots do not fill an empty spot on your squad.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What were the results?[/b][/p][p]Being able to add a small number of bots to lower-skill matches is very positive for matchmaking quality. During off-hours, bots enable us to create fair matches within a reasonable amount of time and reduce how often we have to bring high skill players into a skill-mismatch situation. However, bots are still a work in progress and they can only be added to lobbies where they participate meaningfully. Outside the new player or lower-skill lobbies, they struggle to keep up and cause the match experience to deteriorate and thus we remain dedicated to improving bot behaviours.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What are the next steps?[/b] [/p][p]We will continue to invest in our bots and slowly roll them out to situations where they create a positive player experience. Today, bots have a key role to play in the extended onboarding experience, especially as players learn the games through live matches, and to help facilitate improved matchmaking in situations where we, otherwise, would have had to create very wide matches. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]TEST: DIAMOND + SOLO-QUEUE ONLY [/h2][p][b]Which pain point are we addressing? [/b]Solos vs Premade Imbalance, Lobby Skill Disparity[/p][p][/p][p][b]What is the test?[/b] Later on in Season 29, in all regions, Ranked will be solo-queue only for all players Diamond and above. If you’re Diamond or higher, you won’t be able to squad up as a premade in Ranked. Everyone plays with new friends - no exceptions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why are we doing this? [/b]We see clear frustration amongst Diamond+ players stemming from the imbalance between solo and premade squads, and this is one of the most requested solutions. This constraint should level the playing field and allow everyone to compete, relying only on their own skill and two new squadmates. As a result, lobbies will be more evenly matched and players can trust that they have the same opportunity to win as every other squad in their match. [/p][p][/p][p][b]The trade-off we’re making.[/b] Playing with friends is a core part of Apex. We understand that this test removes that core tenet from Ranked play at the highest tiers, and we know that will sting for players who queue together. With this test, we are prioritizing fairness first as the constraint to understand how it affects matchmaking improvements. We’re measuring whether the fairness gain is worth it, and we’re prepared to hear candid feedback either way. Ultimately, this is just one test to address these pain points; if the test results don't point to this being a long-term solution, we'll evaluate our other approaches to solve this issue.  [/p][p][/p][p]Playing with friends is a key driver of social connection and long-term retention. That said, even highly social players spend a substantial amount of time playing solo. As a result, the solo queue experience cannot be treated as secondary; it is a critical part of the overall player experience, including for our most engaged users.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The data backing this.[/b] It is in Diamond+ that the feedback is the loudest, and our data supports it. Players who play most of their games as a premade squad do make it to the highest tiers at the fastest pace. In matches above Diamond, we also see the largest performance disparity between solo players and premade squads. A three-stack where all players are equally-high skilled is likely to significantly outperform everyone else. The coordination advantage is real. [/p][p][/p][p][b]What we’re watching.[/b] Community sentiment and match data. We want to know if leveling the playing field does improve the overall experience and improves the integrity of Ranked at the top end. This is a two-week window to learn before we decide what’s next.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why not just split the queues?[/b] Splitting queues between solos and premades introduces more issues than it solves. Player populations get fractured into smaller pools, creating longer queue times or much wider matches for everyone. As an oversimplified example: if we split the matchmaking pool and it splits right down the middle, there are 50% fewer players loading into each version of Ranked, meaning that, best case scenario, wait times for each subset will increase 50% and match quality will suffer.[/p][p][/p][p]One queue with a solo-only constraint keeps the player base intact and queue times reasonable. While we’re testing this option to “level the playing field”, we will continue to thoroughly analyze data and sentiment to understand the broader impact of the change before evaluating a more permanent solution.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]TEST: 4.5-HOUR RANKED MAP ROTATIONS[/h2][p][b]Which pain point are we addressing? [/b]General QOL improvement[/p][p][/p][p][b]What did we test?[/b] We shortened the map rotation in Ranked from 24 hours to 4.5 hours. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Why did we test this? [/b]This was mainly a functionality test where we validated that there was no unforeseen negative impact to players or internal systems. We also wanted to understand how the Ranked community would react to being able to play more maps in Ranked during their own normal play schedule over the course of a split.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What were the results?[/b] [/p][p]All clear! Systems were healthy, we saw a greater number of players over a week being able to play on more maps and the community chatter was positive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What are the next steps?[/b] [/p][p]This is now Ranked for everyone. Moving forward, we may continue testing out different rotation schedules to get the best mix of freshness and familiarity.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]ACTIVE TEST: 1-TIER LOCKED RANKED PREMADES[/h2][p][b]Which pain point are we addressing?[/b] Lobby Skill Disparity[/p][p][/p][p][b]What did we test?[/b] [/p][p]Our data shows that Platinum players matching up with Masters is driven primarily by players squadding-up and bringing those wide skill band squads to a lobby. Players often report those pre-match tier distribution graphs with frustration and confusion. As a result, we limited squad-ups to 1 tier above or below your rank, instead of 2, to see if we can create better matches for all.[/p][p][/p][p]This test is currently active at the time of writing, we will follow up with the results when we have them![/p][hr][/hr][h2]THE CHALLENGES OF TESTING[/h2][p]With the deliberate focus on testing matchmaking parameters, sometimes things get broken along the way. It’s a rare and unfortunate outcome, and something we work hard to learn from to ensure we don’t repeat our mistakes.[/p][p]For example, the day of Overclocked’s launch we experienced a matchmaking outage that lasted several hours. We moved too fast, made last-minute changes, missed a crucial bug, and, as a result, the outage impacted our entire playerbase - which is frankly unacceptable.[/p][p][b]So what are we doing differently moving forward?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Process enforcement[/b]: We are demanding stricter adherence to our change‑management workflow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Technical safeguards[/b]: We are implementing automatic mechanisms to release queue pressure automatically, so that future failures can be recovered more gracefully and faster.[/p][/*][/list][p]When something breaks and takes the game offline, the team bands together to resolve it as quickly as possible. When matchmaking systems crash, more and more players accumulate in the queue; if the queue cannot be cleared by loading into matches, it continues to grow, and once it reaches a certain size it overloads the database. To get the game back online, our team had to manually clear the queue and then gradually re‑introduce players at a reduced capacity, starting with 10 % of the usual queue and expanding slowly.[/p][p]Only after sufficient pressure was relieved from the matchmaking queue were we able to restore normal service.`[/p][h2]CONCLUSION[/h2][p]We hope this furthers our transparency surrounding our matchmaking test processes. It is a complicated space to get right, as it requires a delicate balance and rigorous ongoing testing. We will continue to test and iterate, and will communicate with you each step of the way. We have more we’re excited to share with you about Matchmaking and Ranked in the coming months, so stay tuned![/p][p]
[/p]
